ko.title: 다시 그려진 지도, 다시 계산된 승률: 10년 주기 중간에 일어난 선거구획정 다툼이 하원 의원 선거 판세를 바꾸는 방식

segments.src: Congressional district lines are supposed to be redrawn once a decade, after the census.
segments.tr: 연방 하원의원 선거구 경계선은 원래 인구조사(센서스) 이후 10년에 한 번씩 다시 그리도록 되어 있습니다.

segments.src: In recent years, though, several states have gone back to the map between census years.
segments.tr: 하지만 최근 몇 년 동안 여러 주가 인구조사 연도 사이에 지도를 수정하는 작업으로 돌아갔습니다.

segments.src: Lawsuits and court rulings now decide which of those maps voters will actually use.
segments.tr: 이제 소송과 법원 판결에 의해 유권자들이 실제 어느 지도를 사용할지가 결정됩니다.

segments.src: In a closely divided House, even a few districts can change who holds the majority.
segments.tr: 팽팽하게 갈린 하원 구조에서는 단 몇 개 선거구만으로도 다수당 주인이 바뀔 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This explainer covers what mid-decade redistricting is, why it matters, how courts are involved, and what voters can do to stay informed.
segments.tr: 이 설명서에서는 10년 주기 중간의 선거구 재획정이 무엇인지, 왜 중요한지, 법원이 어떻게 개입하는지, 유권자가 계속 최신 정보를 파악하기 위해 무엇을 할 수 있는지를 다룹니다.

segments.src: ## What Is Redistricting, and Why Does It Happen Mid-Decade?
segments.tr: ## 선거구 재획정이란 무엇이며, 왜 10년 주기 중간에 일어날까?

segments.src: Every ten years the U.S.
segments.tr: 10년마다 미국

segments.src: Census counts the population.
segments.tr: 인구조사가 실시되어 인구를 집계합니다.

segments.src: States then use the results to divide their territory into congressional districts of roughly equal population.
segments.tr: 각 주는 그 결과를 바탕으로 자체 관할 구역을 인구가 거의 동등한 연방 하원의원 선거구들로 나누게 됩니다.

segments.src: That process is called redistricting.
segments.tr: 이 과정을 선거구 재획정(redistricting)이라고 부릅니다.

segments.src: Redistricting normally happens once per cycle.
segments.tr: 선거구 재획정은 보통 주기당 한 번씩 일어납니다.

segments.src: A map can be redrawn sooner for several reasons:
segments.tr: 하지만 다음과 같은 몇 가지 이유로 지도가 더 일찍 다시 그려질 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **A court strikes down an existing map.** A judge may find that a map violates the U.S. Constitution, the Voting Rights Act, or a state constitution. The state must then adopt a replacement.
segments.tr: - **법원이 기존 지도를 무효화함.** 판사가 특정 지도가 미 연방 헌법, 투표권법(Voting Rights Act), 또는 주 헌법을 위반했다고 판단할 수 있습니다. 그러면 주는 대체 지도를 채택해야 합니다.

segments.src: - **A legislature chooses to redraw.** In many states, lawmakers can pass a new map at any time unless state law says otherwise.
segments.tr: - **주 의회가 재획정을 선택함.** 많은 주에서 주 법률에 달리 명시되지 않는 한 입법자가 언제든지 새 지도를 통과시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **A state's rules change.** A ballot measure, a new state court interpretation, or a change in a state's redistricting commission can all prompt a new map.
segments.tr: - **주 규칙의 변경.** 주민 투표 안건, 주 법원의 새로운 해석, 또는 주 선거구획정위원회의 변화로 인해 모두 새 지도가 도입될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **A competing state responds.** When one state redraws, officials in other states sometimes weigh whether to do the same.
segments.tr: - **경쟁 관계인 주의 대응.** 한 주가 지도를 다시 그리면, 다른 주의 공직자들도 똑같이 대응할지 여부를 검토하기도 합니다.

segments.src: Each state follows its own rules.
segments.tr: 각 주는 저마다의 규칙을 따릅니다.

segments.src: Some give the legislature the main role.
segments.tr: 어떤 주는 의회에 주도적인 역할을 부여합니다.

segments.src: Others use independent or bipartisan commissions.
segments.tr: 다른 주들은 독립적이거나 초당적인 위원회를 사용합니다.

segments.src: Still others split the work between the two.
segments.tr: 또 다른 주들은 이 두 가지 방식에 업무를 나누어 맡깁니다.

segments.src: ## Why Small Changes Can Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## 미세한 변화가 왜 그토록 큰 영향력을 발휘할까

segments.src: The House has 435 voting seats, and control often comes down to a handful of them.
segments.tr: 하원에는 435개의 의결권 있는 의석이 있으며, 주도권은 종종 몇 안 되는 의석으로 결정됩니다.

segments.src: Recent majorities have been narrow, so shifting even a few competitive districts can change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: 최근의 다수당 의석 차이는 매우 근소했기 때문에, 경합 선거구 몇 개만 이동해도 하원을 지배하는 정당이 바뀔 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Mapmakers have a few common tools:
segments.tr: 지도 제작자들은 몇 가지 공통적인 도구를 사용합니다:

segments.src: - **"Packing"** puts many of one group's voters into a single district. That group wins that seat by a wide margin, and its voting strength is smaller in neighboring districts.
segments.tr: - **"패킹(Packing)"**은 특정 집단의 유권자들을 단일 선거구에 대거 몰아넣는 것입니다. 그 집단은 해당 의석을 큰 격차로 확보하지만, 인접 선거구에서는 투표 영향력이 작아집니다.

segments.src: - **"Cracking"** splits a group's voters across several districts. In each one the group may be too small to win.
segments.tr: - **"크래킹(Cracking)"**은 특정 집단의 유권자들을 여러 선거구로 분산시키는 것입니다. 각 선거구에서 해당 집단의 규모가 너무 작아 승리하지 못할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Adjusting competitive districts.** Moving a few neighborhoods or counties can turn a toss-up seat into a safer one for either side.
segments.tr: - **경합 선거구 조정.** 몇몇 동네나 군(county)을 이동하는 것만으로도 초박빙 의석을 어느 한쪽에 훨씬 유리하고 안전한 의석으로 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: These techniques are lawful in some forms and unlawful in others.
segments.tr: 이러한 기법들은 어떤 형태에서는 합법적이고, 어떤 형태에서는 불법입니다.

segments.src: Courts are often asked to draw that line.
segments.tr: 법원은 종종 그 경계를 긋도록 요청받습니다.

segments.src: ## The Role of the Courts
segments.tr: ## 법원의 역할

segments.src: Several kinds of legal questions come up in redistricting cases.
segments.tr: 선거구 재획정 사건에서는 여러 종류의 법적 질문이 제기됩니다.

segments.src: **Federal law.** Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act bars maps that dilute the voting power of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: **연방 법률.** 투표권법 제2조는 인종적 또는 언어적 소수자 집단의 투표권을 약화시키는 지도를 금지합니다.

segments.src: The Equal Protection Clause also limits how much race may be used when drawing lines.
segments.tr: 평등보호조항 역시 경계선을 그릴 때 인종이 어느 정도까지 반영될 수 있는지를 제한합니다.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has handled many cases on how these rules apply, and its decisions shape what lower courts do.
segments.tr: 연방대법원은 이러한 규칙들이 어떻게 적용되는지에 대한 많은 사건을 처리해 왔으며, 그 판결들은 하급 법원이 집행하는 바를 결정짓습니다.

segments.src: **Partisan gerrymandering.** In 2019, the Supreme Court held in *Rucho v.
segments.tr: **정당별 게리맨더링.** 2019년, 연방대법원은 *Rucho v.

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause* 사건에서 지도가 지나치게 편파적이라는 주장에 대해 연방 법원이 판단을 내릴 수 없다고 판시했습니다.

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: 대법원은 이러한 분쟁이 연방 사법부의 관할 범위를 벗어난 정치적 문제라고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: 이 결정으로 인해 관련 이의 제기는 주 법원과 주 법률의 몫으로 남게 되었습니다.

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **주 헌법.** 많은 주 헌법에는 "자유롭고 공정한 선거" 조항이나 밀집성, 지역사회 유지 등 선거구 재획정을 위한 특정 기준이 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: 여러 주의 주 대법원은 이러한 조항을 근거로 연방 하원의원 선거구 지도를 심사하고, 경우에 따라 거부해 왔습니다.

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **시점.** 선거 일정은 중요합니다.

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: 법원은 선거 임박 시점에 지도를 바꾸는 것이 유권자에게 혼란을 주거나 선거 관리 담당자에게 부담을 줄지 여부를 종종 고려합니다.

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: 판사들은 소송이 진행되는 동안 이의가 제기된 지도를 한 차례의 선거에 그대로 유지하도록 허용하기도 합니다.

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: 이러한 복잡한 단계 때문에 지도가 한 법원에서 무효화되었다가 다른 법원에서 복원된 뒤 다시 재심사를 받을 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: 판결은 후보 등록 마감일이나 예비선거(프라이머리)에 임박해 내려질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## 판결이 권력 구도를 변화시킬 수 있는 방식

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: 법원의 결정은 여러 방식으로 하원에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **주인이 바뀌는 의석.** 지도가 폐기되고 교체되면, 일부 선거구는 특정 정당에 더 유리해지거나 불리해질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **후보자들의 결정.** 현역 의원과 신인 출마자들은 자신이 대표하게 될 선거구를 바탕으로 출마 여부와 출마 지역을 결정합니다.

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: 3. **자금 조달과 관심.** 전국 조직들은 경쟁이 치열하다고 보이는 선거구에 자금과 자원봉사자를 집중시킵니다. 새 지도는 이러한 표적을 이동시키거나 없앨 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **유권자 혼란.** 유권자들은 다른 후보들이 출마하는 새로운 선거구에 자신이 속해 있음을 알게 될 수 있으며, 선거 주기가 늦어질 때까지 이를 인지하지 못할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: 새 지도가 정확히 어떤 결과를 가져올지 아무도 예측할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: 투표율, 후보자의 역량, 전국적인 여론 분위기, 경제 여건 등이 모두 결과에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: 지도는 출발점일 뿐 보증 수표가 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## 유권자가 관심을 가져야 하는 이유

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: 선거구 재획정이 기술적인 문제처럼 보일 수 있지만, 이는 대의민주주의의 기본 요소들을 결정짓습니다:

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.
segments.tr: - **누가 당신을 대표하는가.** 당신의 선거구에 따라 투표할 연방 하원의원과 연방 기관 관련 민원 처리 등 당신의 민원을 담당할 의원이 결정됩니다.

segments.src: - **How competitive your elections are.** In a very safe district, the general election may matter less than the primary.
segments.tr: - **선거가 얼마나 경쟁력 있는가.** 한쪽 정당에 매우 안전한 선거구에서는 본선보다 당내 예비선거가 더 중요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Whether communities stay together.** Lines can keep a town, county, or region whole, or divide it among several districts.
segments.tr: - **지역사회가 하나로 유지되는가.** 경계선은 도시, 군, 또는 지역 전체를 하나로 유지할 수도 있고, 여러 선거구로 분할할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Confidence in elections.** Fights over maps can affect how much people trust the process, whatever their politics.
segments.tr: - **선거에 대한 신뢰.** 지도를 둘러싼 다툼은 정치적 성향과 관계없이 사람들이 선거 과정에 대해 갖는 신뢰도에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What You Can Do
segments.tr: ## 당신이 할 수 있는 일

segments.src: - **Check your district.** Use your state election office's website or a nonpartisan voter guide to confirm your current district before every election. It may have changed.
segments.tr: - **자신의 선거구를 확인하세요.** 매 선거 전에 주 선거 관리 사무소 웹사이트나 초당파적 유권자 안내서를 사용해 현재 선거구를 확인하세요. 지도가 바뀌었을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Verify your registration.** Confirm your registration, polling place, and deadlines with your state or local election office.
segments.tr: - **유권자 등록을 확인하세요.** 주 또는 지역 선거 관리 사무소를 통해 유권자 등록 상태, 투표소 위치, 마감일을 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Follow reliable sources.** Look for coverage from established news outlets and nonpartisan organizations that track redistricting litigation. Court dockets and official state sites are the most direct sources.
segments.tr: - **신뢰할 수 있는 출처를 따르세요.** 선거구 재획정 소송을 추적하는 정평 있는 언론사와 초당파적 단체의 보도를 찾으세요. 법원 사건 수록록과 주 공식 사이트가 가장 직접적인 출처입니다.

segments.src: - **Take part in public processes.** Many states hold hearings or accept public comments on proposed maps. Showing up or submitting comments is one direct way to be heard.
segments.tr: - **공공 절차에 참여하세요.** 많은 주에서 제안된 지도안에 대해 공청회를 열거나 주민 의견을 수렴합니다. 현장에 참석하거나 의견을 제출하는 것은 의견을 직접 전달하는 방법입니다.

segments.src: - **Vote in every election.** Primaries and local races often decide who has power over later redistricting decisions.
segments.tr: - **모든 선거에 투표하세요.** 당내 예비선거와 지방 선거는 추후 선거구 재획정에 영향을 미치는 권력의 주인이 누구인지를 종종 결정합니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: Mid-decade redistricting fights show how much depends on the details of how lines are drawn and who gets to decide.
segments.tr: 10년 주기 중간의 선거구 재획정 다툼은 경계선을 그리는 방식과 이를 결정할 권한이 누구에게 있는지에 대한 세부 사항이 얼마나 중요한지를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Courts at the state and federal level are now weighing which maps will stand, and their rulings can affect which party controls the House.
segments.tr: 주 및 연방 차원의 법원은 이제 어떤 지도가 유지될 것인지를 심리하고 있으며, 이들의 판결은 어느 정당이 하원을 지배할지에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Voters of all views are best served by knowing their district, checking the rules before they vote, and relying on trustworthy sources while the legal picture keeps changing.

zh.title: 重划选区，改写胜算：十年中期重划选区之争如何塑造众议院争夺战

segments.src: Congressional district lines are supposed to be redrawn once a decade, after the census.
segments.tr: 国会选区划分通常在每十年进行一次人口普查之后进行。

segments.src: In recent years, though, several states have gone back to the map between census years.
segments.tr: 然而近年来，几个州在两次人口普查之间重新调整了地图。

segments.src: Lawsuits and court rulings now decide which of those maps voters will actually use.
segments.tr: 诉讼和法院裁决现在决定了选民实际将使用这些地图中的哪一张。

segments.src: In a closely divided House, even a few districts can change who holds the majority.
segments.tr: 在一个势均力敌的众议院中，哪怕只有几个选区也能改变谁拥有多数席位。

segments.src: This explainer covers what mid-decade redistricting is, why it matters, how courts are involved, and what voters can do to stay informed.
segments.tr: 本文解释了什么是十年中期选区重划、为什么它很重要、法院如何参与以及选民可以做些什么来了解最新动态。

segments.src: ## What Is Redistricting, and Why Does It Happen Mid-Decade?
segments.tr: ## 什么是选区重划，为什么它会在十年中期发生？

segments.src: Every ten years the U.S.
segments.tr: 每十年美国

segments.src: Census counts the population.
segments.tr: 人口普查局就会统计一次人口。

segments.src: States then use the results to divide their territory into congressional districts of roughly equal population.
segments.tr: 然后，各州利用普查结果将各自领土划分为人口大致相等的国会选区。

segments.src: That process is called redistricting.
segments.tr: 这个过程被称为选区重划。

segments.src: Redistricting normally happens once per cycle.
segments.tr: 选区重划通常每个周期进行一次。

segments.src: A map can be redrawn sooner for several reasons:
segments.tr: 出于以下几种原因，地图可能会更早地被重新绘制：

segments.src: - **A court strikes down an existing map.** A judge may find that a map violates the U.S. Constitution, the Voting Rights Act, or a state constitution. The state must then adopt a replacement.
segments.tr: - **法院推翻现有地图。** 法官可能会裁定某张地图违反了美国宪法、选举权法案或州宪法。随后该州必须采用替代方案。

segments.src: - **A legislature chooses to redraw.** In many states, lawmakers can pass a new map at any time unless state law says otherwise.
segments.tr: - **立法机构选择重新绘制。** 在许多州，除非州法律另有规定，否则立法者可以在任何时候通过新地图。

segments.src: - **A state's rules change.** A ballot measure, a new state court interpretation, or a change in a state's redistricting commission can all prompt a new map.
segments.tr: - **州的规则发生了变化。** 投票提案、州法院的新解释或州选区重划委员会的变化都可能促成一张新地图。

segments.src: - **A competing state responds.** When one state redraws, officials in other states sometimes weigh whether to do the same.
segments.tr: - **竞争州作出回应。** 当一个州重新绘制地图时，其他州的官员有时会权衡是否采取同样的行动。

segments.src: Each state follows its own rules.
segments.tr: 每个州都遵循自己的规则。

segments.src: Some give the legislature the main role.
segments.tr: 一些州赋予立法机构主要职责。

segments.src: Others use independent or bipartisan commissions.
segments.tr: 另一些州则使用独立或两党委员会。

segments.src: Still others split the work between the two.
segments.tr: 还有一些州在两者之间分工。

segments.src: ## Why Small Changes Can Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## 为什么微小的变化如此重要

segments.src: The House has 435 voting seats, and control often comes down to a handful of them.
segments.tr: 众议院拥有 435 个投票席位，控制权往往取决于其中的一小部分。

segments.src: Recent majorities have been narrow, so shifting even a few competitive districts can change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: 最近的多数派优势微弱，因此哪怕调整几个竞争激烈的选区也能改变哪个党派控制该议院。

segments.src: Mapmakers have a few common tools:
segments.tr: 地图绘制者有一些常用工具：

segments.src: - **"Packing"** puts many of one group's voters into a single district. That group wins that seat by a wide margin, and its voting strength is smaller in neighboring districts.
segments.tr: - **“打包”** 将某一群体的许多选民集中到一个选区中。该群体以较大优势赢得该席位，但在邻近选区中的投票实力就会减弱。

segments.src: - **"Cracking"** splits a group's voters across several districts. In each one the group may be too small to win.
segments.tr: - **“分块”** 将某一群体的选民分散到多个选区。在每个选区中，该群体的数量可能都太少而无法获胜。

segments.src: - **Adjusting competitive districts.** Moving a few neighborhoods or counties can turn a toss-up seat into a safer one for either side.
segments.tr: - **调整竞争性选区。** 移动几个街区或县可以将一个难分胜负的席位变成对任何一方都更稳固的席位。

segments.src: These techniques are lawful in some forms and unlawful in others.
segments.tr: 这些技术在某些形式下是合法的，而在其他形式下是非法的。

segments.src: Courts are often asked to draw that line.
segments.tr: 法院经常被要求划定这一界限。

segments.src: ## The Role of the Courts
segments.tr: ## 法院的角色

segments.src: Several kinds of legal questions come up in redistricting cases.
segments.tr: 在选区重划案件中会出现几种法律问题。

segments.src: **Federal law.** Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act bars maps that dilute the voting power of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: **联邦法律。** 《选举权法案》第二条禁止削弱种族或语言少数群体投票权的地图。

segments.src: The Equal Protection Clause also limits how much race may be used when drawing lines.
segments.tr: 平等保护条款也限制了在划定边界时可以使用种族因素的程度。

segments.src: The Supreme Court has handled many cases on how these rules apply, and its decisions shape what lower courts do.
segments.tr: 最高法院处理了许多关于这些规则如何适用的案件，其裁决塑造了下级法院的做法。

segments.src: **Partisan gerrymandering.** In 2019, the Supreme Court held in *Rucho v.
segments.tr: **党派杰利蝾螈（不公正划分选区）。** 2019 年，最高法院在 *Rucho v.

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause* 案中裁定，联邦法院不能裁决关于某张地图过于偏向某一党派的诉求。

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: 法院表示，这些争端是超出联邦司法管辖范围的政治问题。

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: 该裁决将挑战留给了州法院和州法律。

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **州宪法。** 许多州宪法包含“自由和公正选举”条款或关于选区重划的具体标准，例如紧凑性或保持社区完整。

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: 几个州的州最高法院利用这些规定审查并有时否决了国会地图。

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **时间安排。** 选举日程很重要。

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: 法院经常考虑在临近选举时更改地图是否会混淆选民或给选举官员带来负担。

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: 法官有时会允许受到质疑的地图在诉讼继续期间保留一届选举。

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: 由于这些层级，一张地图可能在一个法院被推翻，由另一个法院恢复，然后再次接受审查。

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: 裁决可能会在接近提交候选人截止日期或初选时到达。

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## 裁决如何改变权力平衡

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: 法院裁决可以从几个方面影响众议院：

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **易手席位。** 如果一张地图被废弃并替换，一些选区对特定政党的有利程度可能会增加或减少。

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **候选人决定。** 现任官员和挑战者根据他们将代表的选区决定是否参选以及在哪里参选。

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: 3. **筹款和关注。** 全国性组织将资金和志愿者引导至他们认为具有竞争力的选区。新地图可以移动或移除这些目标。

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **选民困惑。** 选民可能会发现自己身处一个拥有不同候选人的新选区，并且可能直到选举周期的后期才知道这一点。

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: 没有人能准确预测新地图的表现。

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: 投票率、候选人质量、全国情绪和经济都会影响结果。

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: 地图是一个起点，而不是保证。

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## 为什么选民应该关心

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: 选区重划可能看起来很技术性，但它塑造了代表制的一些基本部分：

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.
segments.tr: - **谁代表你。** 你的选区决定了你投票选举哪位国会议员，以及谁来处理你的个案工作，例如协助联系联邦机构。

segments.src: - **How competitive your elections are.** In a very safe district, the general election may matter less than the primary.
segments.tr: - **你的选举有多大竞争性。** 在一个非常稳固的选区中，大选可能不如初选那么重要。

segments.src: - **Whether communities stay together.** Lines can keep a town, county, or region whole, or divide it among several districts.
segments.tr: - **社区是否保持完整。** 边界可以使一个城镇、县或地区保持完整，也可以将其分到几个选区中。

segments.src: - **Confidence in elections.** Fights over maps can affect how much people trust the process, whatever their politics.
segments.tr: - **对选举的信心。** 无论政治立场如何，关于地图的争斗都会影响人们对这一过程的信任程度。

segments.src: ## What You Can Do
segments.tr: ## 你能做些什么

segments.src: - **Check your district.** Use your state election office's website or a nonpartisan voter guide to confirm your current district before every election. It may have changed.
segments.tr: - **检查你的选区。** 在每次选举前，使用你所在的州选举办公室的网站或无党派选民指南来确认你当前的选区。它可能已经改变了。

segments.src: - **Verify your registration.** Confirm your registration, polling place, and deadlines with your state or local election office.
segments.tr: - **验证你的选民登记。** 向你所在州或地方的选举办公室确认你的登记、投票地点和截止日期。

segments.src: - **Follow reliable sources.** Look for coverage from established news outlets and nonpartisan organizations that track redistricting litigation. Court dockets and official state sites are the most direct sources.
segments.tr: - **关注可靠来源。** 寻找来自老牌新闻机构和追踪选区重划诉讼的无党派组织的报道。法院案卷和官方州网站是最直接的来源。

segments.src: - **Take part in public processes.** Many states hold hearings or accept public comments on proposed maps. Showing up or submitting comments is one direct way to be heard.
segments.tr: - **参与公共程序。** 许多州就拟议的地图举行听证会或接受公众意见。出席或提交意见是被倾听的直接方式之一。

segments.src: - **Vote in every election.** Primaries and local races often decide who has power over later redistricting decisions.
segments.tr: - **在每次选举中投票。** 初选和地方竞选通常决定了谁拥有对未来选区重划决策的权力。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: Mid-decade redistricting fights show how much depends on the details of how lines are drawn and who gets to decide.
segments.tr: 十年中期的选区重划之争表明，有多少事情取决于划定边界细节以及由谁来决定。

segments.src: Courts at the state and federal level are now weighing which maps will stand, and their rulings can affect which party controls the House.
segments.tr: 州和联邦级别的法院现在正在权衡哪些地图将保留，其裁决可能会影响哪个党派控制众议院。

segments.src: Voters of all views are best served by knowing their district, checking the rules before they vote, and relying on trustworthy sources while the legal picture keeps changing.
segments.tr: 无论什么观点的选民，最好的应对方式是了解自己的选区，在投票前检查规则，并在法律状况不断变化时依靠值得信赖的来源。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not endorse any party, candidate, or map.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，不背书任何政党、候选人或地图。

segments.src: Redistricting law and litigation change quickly, so check official state election websites and reliable news sources for current information.*
segments.tr: 选区重划法律和诉讼变化迅速，因此请查看官方州选举网站和可靠的新闻来源以获取最新信息。*

segments.src: ## What Is Redistricting, and Why Does It Happen Mid-Decade?
segments.tr: ## परिसीमन क्या है, और यह दशक के मध्य में क्यों होता है?

segments.src: Every ten years the U.S.
segments.tr: हर दस साल में U.S.

segments.src: Census counts the population.
segments.tr: जनगणना (Census) जनसंख्या की गिनती करती है।

segments.src: States then use the results to divide their territory into congressional districts of roughly equal population.
segments.tr: इसके बाद राज्य इन परिणामों का उपयोग अपने क्षेत्र को लगभग समान जनसंख्या वाले कांग्रेशनल निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों में विभाजित करने के लिए करते हैं।

segments.src: That process is called redistricting.
segments.tr: इस प्रक्रिया को परिसीमन (redistricting) कहा जाता है।

segments.src: Redistricting normally happens once per cycle.
segments.tr: परिसीमन सामान्यतः प्रति चक्र एक बार होता है।

segments.src: A map can be redrawn sooner for several reasons:
segments.tr: कई कारणों से किसी नक्शे को पहले भी फिर से बनाया जा सकता है:

segments.src: - **A court strikes down an existing map.** A judge may find that a map violates the U.S. Constitution, the Voting Rights Act, or a state constitution. The state must then adopt a replacement.
segments.tr: - **अदालत द्वारा मौजूदा नक्शे को रद्द करना।** एक न्यायाधीश पा सकता है कि कोई नक्शा U.S. संविधान, मतदान अधिकार अधिनियम (Voting Rights Act), या राज्य के संविधान का उल्लंघन करता है। इसके बाद राज्य को एक नया नक्शा अपनाना होगा।

segments.src: - **A legislature chooses to redraw.** In many states, lawmakers can pass a new map at any time unless state law says otherwise.
segments.tr: - **विधायिका द्वारा फिर से नया नक्शा बनाने का विकल्प चुनना।** कई राज्यों में, जब तक कि राज्य का कानून अन्यथा न कहे, कानून निर्माता किसी भी समय एक नया नक्शा पारित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **A state's rules change.** A ballot measure, a new state court interpretation, or a change in a state's redistricting commission can all prompt a new map.
segments.tr: - **राज्य के नियमों में बदलाव।** एक बैलेट उपाय (ballot measure), राज्य की अदालत द्वारा नई व्याख्या, या राज्य के परिसीमन आयोग में बदलाव—ये सभी एक नए नक्शे को प्रेरित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **A competing state responds.** When one state redraws, officials in other states sometimes weigh whether to do the same.
segments.tr: - **प्रतिस्पर्धी राज्य का जवाब देना।** जब एक राज्य फिर से नक्शा बनाता है, तो अन्य राज्यों के अधिकारी कभी-कभी विचार करते हैं कि क्या उन्हें भी ऐसा ही करना चाहिए।

segments.src: Each state follows its own rules.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक राज्य अपने नियमों का पालन करता है।

segments.src: Some give the legislature the main role.
segments.tr: कुछ राज्य विधायिका को मुख्य भूमिका देते हैं।

segments.src: Others use independent or bipartisan commissions.
segments.tr: अन्य स्वतंत्र या द्विदलीय (bipartisan) आयोगों का उपयोग करते हैं।

segments.src: Still others split the work between the two.
segments.tr: फिर भी कुछ अन्य दोनों के बीच काम को विभाजित करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why Small Changes Can Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## छोटे बदलाव इतने मायने क्यों रख सकते हैं

segments.src: The House has 435 voting seats, and control often comes down to a handful of them.
segments.tr: हाउस में 435 मतदान सीटें हैं, और नियंत्रण अक्सर उनमें से कुछ पर ही आकर टिक जाता है।

segments.src: Recent majorities have been narrow, so shifting even a few competitive districts can change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: हाल के बहुमत मामूली अंतर वाले रहे हैं, इसलिए कुछ प्रतिस्पर्धी क्षेत्रों को बदलने से भी यह बदल सकता है कि कौन सी पार्टी सदन को नियंत्रित करती है।

segments.src: Mapmakers have a few common tools:
segments.tr: नक्शा बनाने वालों के पास कुछ सामान्य उपकरण होते हैं:

segments.src: - **"Packing"** puts many of one group's voters into a single district. That group wins that seat by a wide margin, and its voting strength is smaller in neighboring districts.
segments.tr: - **"पैकिंग" ("Packing")** एक समूह के कई मतदाताओं को एक ही निर्वाचन क्षेत्र में डाल देती है। वह समूह बड़े अंतर से वह सीट जीत जाता है, और पड़ोसी क्षेत्रों में उसकी मतदान शक्ति कम हो जाती है।

segments.src: - **"Cracking"** splits a group's voters across several districts. In each one the group may be too small to win.
segments.tr: - **"क्रैकिंग" ("Cracking")** एक समूह के मतदाताओं को कई निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों में बांट देती है। प्रत्येक में वह समूह जीतने के लिए बहुत छोटा हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Adjusting competitive districts.** Moving a few neighborhoods or counties can turn a toss-up seat into a safer one for either side.
segments.tr: - **प्रतिस्पर्धी क्षेत्रों का समायोजन।** कुछ पड़ोस या काउंटियों को स्थानांतरित करने से किसी भी पक्ष के लिए अनिश्चित सीट अधिक सुरक्षित सीट में बदल सकती है।

segments.src: These techniques are lawful in some forms and unlawful in others.
segments.tr: ये तकनीकें कुछ रूपों में वैध हैं और अन्य में अवैध।

segments.src: Courts are often asked to draw that line.
segments.tr: अदालतों से अक्सर उस रेखा को खींचने के लिए कहा जाता है।

segments.src: ## The Role of the Courts
segments.tr: ## अदालतों की भूमिका

segments.src: Several kinds of legal questions come up in redistricting cases.
segments.tr: परिसीमन के मामलों में कई तरह के कानूनी सवाल उठते हैं।

segments.src: **Federal law.** Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act bars maps that dilute the voting power of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: **संघीय कानून (Federal law).** मतदान अधिकार अधिनियम (Voting Rights Act) की धारा 2 उन नक्शों पर रोक लगाती है जो नस्लीय या भाषाई अल्पसंख्यक समूहों की मतदान शक्ति को कमजोर करते हैं।

segments.src: The Equal Protection Clause also limits how much race may be used when drawing lines.
segments.tr: समान संरक्षण खंड (Equal Protection Clause) भी सीमाएं खींचते समय नस्ल का कितना उपयोग किया जा सकता है, इसे सीमित करता है।

segments.src: The Supreme Court has handled many cases on how these rules apply, and its decisions shape what lower courts do.
segments.tr: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने इन नियमों को लागू करने के तरीके पर कई मामलों को संभाला है, और इसके फैसले तय करते हैं कि निचली अदालतें क्या करती हैं।

segments.src: **Partisan gerrymandering.** In 2019, the Supreme Court held in *Rucho v.
segments.tr: **दलगत पक्षपात (Partisan gerrymandering).** 2019 में, सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने *Rucho v.

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause* में माना कि संघीय अदालतें इस दावे का फैसला नहीं कर सकतीं कि कोई नक्शा बहुत अधिक पक्षपातपूर्ण है।

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: कोर्ट ने कहा कि ये विवाद राजनीतिक प्रश्न हैं जो संघीय न्यायपालिका की पहुंच से बाहर हैं।

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: इस फैसले ने चुनौतियों को राज्य की अदालतों और राज्य के कानून पर छोड़ दिया।

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **राज्य के संविधान।** कई राज्य के संविधानों में "स्वतंत्र और निष्पक्ष चुनाव" खंड या परिसीमन के लिए विशिष्ट मानक शामिल हैं, जैसे कि सघनता या समुदायों को एक साथ रखना।

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: कई राज्यों में राज्य के सर्वोच्च न्यायालयों ने कांग्रेशनल नक्शों की समीक्षा करने और कुछ मामलों में उन्हें खारिज करने के लिए इन प्रावधानों का उपयोग किया है।

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **समय।** चुनाव कैलेंडर मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: अदालतें अक्सर विचार करती हैं कि क्या चुनाव के करीब किसी नक्शे को बदलने से मतदाता भ्रमित होंगे या चुनाव अधिकारियों पर बोझ पड़ेगा।

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: न्यायाधीश कभी-कभी चुनौती दिए गए नक्शे को एक चुनाव के लिए लागू रहने की अनुमति देते हैं जबकि मामला जारी रहता है।

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: इन परतों के कारण, एक नक्शा एक अदालत में रद्द किया जा सकता है, दूसरी द्वारा बहाल किया जा सकता है, और फिर से समीक्षा की जा सकती है।

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: फैसले नामांकन की समय सीमा या प्राइमरी चुनाव के करीब आ सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## फैसले सत्ता के संतुलन को कैसे बदल सकते हैं

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: एक अदालती फैसला हाउस को कई तरीकों से प्रभावित कर सकता है:

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **सीटें जो हाथ बदलती हैं।** यदि कोई नक्शा खारिज कर दिया जाता है और बदल दिया जाता है, तो कुछ निर्वाचन क्षेत्र किसी दिए गए दल के लिए अधिक या कम अनुकूल हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **उम्मीदवारों के फैसले।** पदधारी और चुनौती देने वाले इस आधार पर चुनाव लड़ने और कहाँ से लड़ने का निर्णय लेते हैं कि वे किस निर्वाचन क्षेत्र का प्रतिनिधित्व करेंगे।

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: 3. **फंडरेज़िंग और ध्यान।** राष्ट्रीय समूह उन क्षेत्रों में धन और स्वयंसेवकों को निर्देशित करते हैं जिन्हें वे प्रतिस्पर्धी मानते हैं। एक नया नक्शा उन लक्ष्यों को स्थानांतरित या हटा सकता है।

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **मतदाताओं का भ्रम।** मतदाता खुद को अलग-अलग उम्मीदवारों वाले एक नए निर्वाचन क्षेत्र में पा सकते हैं, और चुनाव चक्र में देर होने तक उन्हें इसका पता नहीं चल सकता है।

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: कोई भी सटीक भविष्यवाणी नहीं कर सकता कि एक नया नक्शा कैसा प्रदर्शन करेगा।

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: मतदान का प्रतिशत, उम्मीदवार की गुणवत्ता, राष्ट्रीय माहौल और अर्थव्यवस्था सभी परिणामों को प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: एक नक्शा एक शुरुआती बिंदु है, कोई गारंटी नहीं।

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## मतदाताओं को परवाह क्यों करनी चाहिए

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: परिसीमन तकनीकी लग सकता है, लेकिन यह प्रतिनिधित्व के कुछ बुनियादी हिस्सों को आकार देता है:

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.
segments.tr: - **आपका प्रतिनिधित्व कौन करता है।** आपका निर्वाचन क्षेत्र तय करता है कि आप कांग्रेस के किस सदस्य के लिए वोट करते हैं और कौन आपके मामलों को संभालता है, जैसे कि संघीय एजेंसियों से मदद।

segments.src: - **How competitive your elections are.** In a very safe district, the general election may matter less than the primary.
segments.tr: - **आपके चुनाव कितने प्रतिस्पर्धी हैं।** एक बहुत ही सुरक्षित क्षेत्र में, आम चुनाव की तुलना में प्राइमरी चुनाव अधिक मायने रख सकता है।

segments.src: - **Whether communities stay together.** Lines can keep a town, county, or region whole, or divide it among several districts.
segments.tr: - **क्या समुदाय एक साथ रहते हैं।** सीमाएं एक कस्बे, काउंटी या क्षेत्र को अखंड रख सकती हैं, या इसे कई क्षेत्रों के बीच विभाजित कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Confidence in elections.** Fights over maps can affect how much people trust the process, whatever their politics.
segments.tr: - **चुनावों में विश्वास।** नक्शों को लेकर लड़ाई इस बात को प्रभावित कर सकती है कि लोग प्रक्रिया पर कितना भरोसा करते हैं, चाहे उनकी राजनीति कुछ भी हो।

segments.src: ## What You Can Do
segments.tr: ## आप क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: - **Check your district.** Use your state election office's website or a nonpartisan voter guide to confirm your current district before every election. It may have changed.
segments.tr: - **अपने निर्वाचन क्षेत्र की जाँच करें।** हर चुनाव से पहले अपने वर्तमान क्षेत्र की पुष्टि करने के लिए अपने राज्य के चुनाव कार्यालय की वेबसाइट या गैर-पक्षपाती मतदाता निर्देशिका का उपयोग करें। यह बदल गया होगा।

segments.src: - **Verify your registration.** Confirm your registration, polling place, and deadlines with your state or local election office.
segments.tr: - **अपने पंजीकरण का सत्यापन करें।** अपने राज्य या स्थानीय चुनाव कार्यालय के साथ अपने पंजीकरण, मतदान स्थल और समय सीमा की पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: - **Follow reliable sources.** Look for coverage from established news outlets and nonpartisan organizations that track redistricting litigation. Court dockets and official state sites are the most direct sources.
segments.tr: - **विश्वसनीय स्रोतों का अनुसरण करें।** स्थापित समाचार आउटलेट्स और गैर-पक्षपाती संगठनों से कवरेज देखें जो परिसीमन मुकदमेबाजी को ट्रैक करते हैं। कोर्ट डॉकेट और आधिकारिक राज्य साइटें सबसे प्रत्यक्ष स्रोत हैं।

segments.src: - **Take part in public processes.** Many states hold hearings or accept public comments on proposed maps. Showing up or submitting comments is one direct way to be heard.
segments.tr: - **सार्वजनिक प्रक्रियाओं में भाग लें।** कई राज्य सुनवाई करते हैं या प्रस्तावित नक्शों पर सार्वजनिक टिप्पणियां स्वीकार करते हैं। उपस्थित होना या टिप्पणियाँ जमा करना अपनी बात रखने का एक सीधा तरीका है।

segments.src: - **Vote in every election.** Primaries and local races often decide who has power over later redistricting decisions.
segments.tr: - **हर चुनाव में वोट दें।** प्राइमरी और स्थानीय दौड़ अक्सर यह तय करती हैं कि बाद के परिसीमन के फैसलों पर किसकी सत्ता होगी।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## मुख्य बात

segments.src: Mid-decade redistricting fights show how much depends on the details of how lines are drawn and who gets to decide.
segments.tr: दशक के मध्य में परिसीमन की लड़ाई दिखाती है कि सीमाएं कैसे खींची जाती हैं और कौन निर्णय लेता है, इसके विवरण पर कितना कुछ निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: Courts at the state and federal level are now weighing which maps will stand, and their rulings can affect which party controls the House.
segments.tr: राज्य और संघीय स्तर पर अदालतें अब विचार कर रही हैं कि कौन से नक्शे कायम रहेंगे, और उनके फैसले यह प्रभावित कर सकते हैं कि कौन सी पार्टी हाउस को नियंत्रित करती है।

segments.src: Voters of all views are best served by knowing their district, checking the rules before they vote, and relying on trustworthy sources while the legal picture keeps changing.
segments.tr: सभी विचारों के मतदाताओं के लिए सबसे अच्छा यह है कि वे अपने निर्वाचन क्षेत्र को जानें, वोट देने से पहले नियमों की जांच करें, और कानूनी तस्वीर बदलते रहने के दौरान भरोसेमंद स्रोतों पर भरोसा करें।

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not endorse any party, candidate, or map.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य जानकारी के उद्देश्यों के लिए है और किसी भी पार्टी, उम्मीदवार या नक्शे का समर्थन नहीं करता है।

segments.src: Redistricting law and litigation change quickly, so check official state election websites and reliable news sources for current information.*

es.title: Mapas redibujados, probabilidades redibujadas: cómo las luchas de redistribución de distritos a mitad de década están moldeando la carrera por la Cámara

segments.src: Congressional district lines are supposed to be redrawn once a decade, after the census.
segments.tr: Se supone que las líneas de los distritos congresionales deben redibujarse una vez por década, después del censo.

segments.src: In recent years, though, several states have gone back to the map between census years.
segments.tr: En los últimos años, sin embargo, varios estados han regresado al mapa entre los años del censo.

segments.src: Lawsuits and court rulings now decide which of those maps voters will actually use.
segments.tr: Las demandas y los fallos judiciales ahora deciden cuáles de esos mapas usarán realmente los votantes.

segments.src: In a closely divided House, even a few districts can change who holds the majority.
segments.tr: En una Cámara estrechamente dividida, incluso unos pocos distritos pueden cambiar quién tiene la mayoría.

segments.src: This explainer covers what mid-decade redistricting is, why it matters, how courts are involved, and what voters can do to stay informed.
segments.tr: Este explicador cubre qué es la redistribución de distritos a mitad de década, por qué importa, cómo participan los tribunales y qué pueden hacer los votantes para mantenerse informados.

segments.src: ## What Is Redistricting, and Why Does It Happen Mid-Decade?
segments.tr: ## ¿Qué es la redistribución de distritos y por qué ocurre a mitad de década?

segments.src: Every ten years the U.S.
segments.tr: Cada diez años, el censo de EE. UU.

segments.src: Census counts the population.
segments.tr: cuenta la población.

segments.src: States then use the results to divide their territory into congressional districts of roughly equal population.
segments.tr: Luego, los estados utilizan los resultados para dividir su territorio en distritos congresionales de población aproximadamente igual.

segments.src: That process is called redistricting.
segments.tr: Ese proceso se llama redistribución de distritos.

segments.src: Redistricting normally happens once per cycle.
segments.tr: La redistribución de distritos normalmente ocurre una vez por ciclo.

segments.src: A map can be redrawn sooner for several reasons:
segments.tr: Un mapa puede ser rediseñado antes por varias razones:

segments.src: - **A court strikes down an existing map.** A judge may find that a map violates the U.S. Constitution, the Voting Rights Act, or a state constitution. The state must then adopt a replacement.
segments.tr: - **Un tribunal anula un mapa existente.** Un juez puede considerar que un mapa viola la Constitución de EE. UU., la Ley de Derechos Electorales o una constitución estatal. El estado debe entonces adoptar un reemplazo.

segments.src: - **A legislature chooses to redraw.** In many states, lawmakers can pass a new map at any time unless state law says otherwise.
segments.tr: - **Una legislatura decide redibujar.** En muchos estados, los legisladores pueden aprobar un nuevo mapa en cualquier momento a menos que la ley estatal diga lo contrario.

segments.src: - **A state's rules change.** A ballot measure, a new state court interpretation, or a change in a state's redistricting commission can all prompt a new map.
segments.tr: - **Las reglas de un estado cambian.** Una medida electoral, una nueva interpretación de un tribunal estatal o un cambio en la comisión de redistribución de distritos de un estado pueden impulsar un nuevo mapa.

segments.src: - **A competing state responds.** When one state redraws, officials in other states sometimes weigh whether to do the same.
segments.tr: - **Un estado competidor responde.** Cuando un estado redibuja, los funcionarios de otros estados a veces evalúan si deben hacer lo mismo.

segments.src: Each state follows its own rules.
segments.tr: Cada estado sigue sus propias reglas.

segments.src: Some give the legislature the main role.
segments.tr: Algunos dan a la legislatura el papel principal.

segments.src: Others use independent or bipartisan commissions.
segments.tr: Otros utilizan comisiones independientes o bipartidistas.

segments.src: Still others split the work between the two.
segments.tr: Aún otros dividen el trabajo entre ambos.

segments.src: ## Why Small Changes Can Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## Por qué los pequeños cambios pueden importar tanto

segments.src: The House has 435 voting seats, and control often comes down to a handful of them.
segments.tr: La Cámara tiene 435 escaños con derecho a voto, y el control a menudo se reduce a un puñado de ellos.

segments.src: Recent majorities have been narrow, so shifting even a few competitive districts can change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: Las mayorías recientes han sido estrechas, por lo que cambiar incluso unos pocos distritos competitivos puede cambiar qué partido controla la cámara.

segments.src: Mapmakers have a few common tools:
segments.tr: Los creadores de mapas tienen algunas herramientas comunes:

segments.src: - **"Packing"** puts many of one group's voters into a single district. That group wins that seat by a wide margin, and its voting strength is smaller in neighboring districts.
segments.tr: - **"Packing" (Concentración)** coloca a muchos votantes de un grupo en un solo distrito. Ese grupo gana ese escaño por un margen amplio, y su fuerza electoral es menor en los distritos vecinos.

segments.src: - **"Cracking"** splits a group's voters across several districts. In each one the group may be too small to win.
segments.tr: - **"Cracking" (Fragmentación)** divide a los votantes de un grupo en varios distritos. En cada uno de ellos, el grupo puede ser demasiado pequeño para ganar.

segments.src: - **Adjusting competitive districts.** Moving a few neighborhoods or counties can turn a toss-up seat into a safer one for either side.
segments.tr: - **Ajustar los distritos competitivos.** Mover unos pocos vecindarios o condados puede convertir un escaño reñido en uno más seguro para cualquiera de los dos bandos.

segments.src: These techniques are lawful in some forms and unlawful in others.
segments.tr: Estas técnicas son lícitas de algunas formas e ilícitas en otras.

segments.src: Courts are often asked to draw that line.
segments.tr: A menudo se pide a los tribunales que tracen esa línea.

segments.src: ## The Role of the Courts
segments.tr: ## El papel de los tribunales

segments.src: Several kinds of legal questions come up in redistricting cases.
segments.tr: Varios tipos de cuestiones legales surgen en los casos de redistribución de distritos.

segments.src: **Federal law.** Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act bars maps that dilute the voting power of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: **Ley federal.** La Sección 2 de la Ley de Derechos Electorales prohíbe los mapas que diluyen el poder de voto de los grupos minoritarios raciales o lingüísticos.

segments.src: The Equal Protection Clause also limits how much race may be used when drawing lines.
segments.tr: La Cláusula de Igual Protección también limita cuánta raza se puede usar al trazar líneas.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has handled many cases on how these rules apply, and its decisions shape what lower courts do.
segments.tr: La Corte Suprema ha manejado muchos casos sobre cómo se aplican estas reglas, y sus decisiones moldean lo que hacen los tribunales inferiores.

segments.src: **Partisan gerrymandering.** In 2019, the Supreme Court held in *Rucho v.
segments.tr: **Manipulación partidista de distritos (gerrymandering).** En 2019, la Corte Suprema sostuvo en el caso *Rucho v.

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause* que los tribunales federales no pueden decidir reclamaciones de que un mapa es demasiado partidista.

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: La Corte dijo que esas disputas son cuestiones políticas fuera del alcance del poder judicial federal.

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: La decisión dejó las impugnaciones a los tribunales estatales y a la ley estatal.

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **Constituciones estatales.** Muchas constituciones estatales incluyen cláusulas de "elecciones libres y justas" o estándares específicos para la redistribución de distritos, como la compacidad o mantener a las comunidades juntas.

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: Los tribunales supremos estatales en varios estados han utilizado estas disposiciones para revisar y, en algunos casos, rechazar mapas congresionales.

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **Cronograma.** Los calendarios electorales importan.

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: Los tribunales a menudo consideran si cambiar un mapa cerca de una elección confundiría a los votantes o agobiaría a los funcionarios electorales.

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: Los jueces a veces permiten que un mapa impugnado permanezca en su lugar por una elección mientras el caso continúa.

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: Debido a estas capas, un mapa puede ser anulado en un tribunal, restaurado por otro y luego revisado nuevamente.

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: Los fallos pueden llegar cerca de los plazos de presentación o de las primarias.

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## Cómo los fallos pueden cambiar el equilibrio de poder

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: Una decisión judicial puede afectar a la Cámara de varias maneras:

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **Escaños que cambian de manos.** Si un mapa es descartado y reemplazado, algunos distritos pueden volverse más o menos favorables para un partido determinado.

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **Decisiones de los candidatos.** Los titulares y los retadores deciden si se postulan, y dónde, en función del distrito que representarían.

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: 3. **Recaudación de fondos y atención.** Los grupos nacionales dirigen dinero y voluntarios a los distritos que consideran competitivos. Un mapa nuevo puede mover o eliminar esos objetivos.

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **Confusión de los votantes.** Los votantes pueden encontrarse en un distrito nuevo con diferentes candidatos, y es posible que no se enteren de esto hasta avanzado el ciclo.

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: Nadie puede predecir exactamente cómo se desempeñará un nuevo mapa.

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: La participación, la calidad de los candidatos, el clima nacional y la economía afectan los resultados.

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: Un mapa es un punto de partida, no una garantía.

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## Por qué los votantes deberían importarle

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: La redistribución de distritos puede parecer técnica, pero moldea algunas partes básicas de la representación:

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.
segments.tr: - **Quién lo representa.** Su distrito determina por qué miembro del Congreso vota y quién maneja sus casos, como la ayuda con agencias federales.

segments.src: - **How competitive your elections are.** In a very safe district, the general election may matter less than the primary.
segments.tr: - **Qué tan competitivas son sus elecciones.** En un distrito muy seguro, la elección general puede importar menos que las primarias.

segments.src: - **Whether communities stay together.** Lines can keep a town, county, or region whole, or divide it among several districts.
segments.tr: - **Si las comunidades se mantienen juntas.** Las líneas pueden mantener un pueblo, condado o región entero, o dividirlo entre varios distritos.

segments.src: - **Confidence in elections.** Fights over maps can affect how much people trust the process, whatever their politics.
segments.tr: - **Confianza en las elecciones.** Las luchas por los mapas pueden afectar cuánta confianza tiene la gente en el proceso, cualesquiera que sean sus posturas políticas.

segments.src: ## What You Can Do
segments.tr: ## Qué puede hacer usted

segments.src: - **Check your district.** Use your state election office's website or a nonpartisan voter guide to confirm your current district before every election. It may have changed.
segments.tr: - **Verifique su distrito.** Use el sitio web de la oficina electoral de su estado o una guía de votantes no partidista para confirmar su distrito actual antes de cada elección. Es posible que haya cambiado.

segments.src: - **Verify your registration.** Confirm your registration, polling place, and deadlines with your state or local election office.
segments.tr: - **Verifique su registro.** Confirme su registro, lugar de votación y plazos con su oficina electoral estatal o local.

segments.src: - **Follow reliable sources.** Look for coverage from established news outlets and nonpartisan organizations that track redistricting litigation. Court dockets and official state sites are the most direct sources.
segments.tr: - **Siga fuentes confiables.** Busque cobertura de medios de comunicación establecidos y organizaciones no partidistas que rastreen los litigios de redistribución de distritos. Los expedientes judiciales y los sitios oficiales del estado son las fuentes más directas.

segments.src: - **Take part in public processes.** Many states hold hearings or accept public comments on proposed maps. Showing up or submitting comments is one direct way to be heard.
segments.tr: - **Participe en procesos públicos.** Muchos estados celebran audiencias o aceptan comentarios públicos sobre los mapas propuestos. Asistir o presentar comentarios es una forma directa de ser escuchado.

segments.src: - **Vote in every election.** Primaries and local races often decide who has power over later redistricting decisions.
segments.tr: - **Vote en cada elección.** Las primarias y las carreras locales a menudo deciden quién tiene el poder sobre las decisiones posteriores de redistribución de distritos.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En resumen

segments.src: Mid-decade redistricting fights show how much depends on the details of how lines are drawn and who gets to decide.
segments.tr: Las luchas de redistribución de distritos a mitad de década muestran cuánto depende de los detalles de cómo se trazan las líneas y quién llega a decidir.

segments.src: Courts at the state and federal level are now weighing which maps will stand, and their rulings can affect which party controls the House.
segments.tr: Los tribunales a nivel estatal y federal ahora están evaluando qué mapas se mantendrán, y sus fallos pueden afectar qué partido controla la Cámara.

segments.src: Voters of all views are best served by knowing their district, checking the rules before they vote, and relying on trustworthy sources while the legal picture keeps changing.
segments.tr: A los votantes de todas las opiniones les conviene más conocer su distrito, verificar las reglas antes de votar y confiar en fuentes fidedignas mientras el panorama legal sigue cambiando.

segments.tr: **التلاعب الحزبي بالدوائر الانتخابية.** في عام 2019، قضت المحكمة العليا في قضية *Rucho v.

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause* أن المحاكم الفيدرالية لا يمكنها البت في الادعاءات بأن الخريطة حزبية للغاية.

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: قالت المحكمة إن هذه النزاعات هي مسائل سياسية خارج نطاق السلطة القضائية الفيدرالية.

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: ترك القرار التحديات لمحاكم ولايات وقوانين ولايات.

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **دساتير الولاية.** تتضمن العديد من دساتير الولايات بنوداً تتعلق "بالانتخابات الحرة والنزيهة" أو معايير محددة لإعادة تقسيم الدوائر، مثل التقارب أو إبقاء المجتمعات معاً.

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: استخدمت المحاكم العليا في عدة ولايات هذه الأحكام لمراجعة ورفض خرائط الكونغرس في بعض الحالات.

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **التوقيت.** تقاويم الانتخابات مهمة.

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تنظر المحاكم فيما إذا كان تغيير خريطة قريب من الانتخابات سيربك الناخبين أو يثقل كاهل مسؤولي الانتخابات.

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: تسمح المحاكم أحياناً لخريطة مطعون فيها بالبقاء في مكانها لانتخاب واحد بينما تستمر القضية.

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: بسبب هذه الطبقات، يمكن إبطال خريطة في محكمة واحدة، وإعادة إرسائها من قبل أخرى، ثم مراجعتها مرة أخرى.

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تصل الأحكام بالقرب من المواعيد النهائية لتقديم الترشيحات أو الانتخابات التمهيدية.

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## كيف يمكن للأحكام أن تحول ميزان القوى

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: يمكن لقرار المحكمة أن يؤثر على مجلس النواب بعدة طرق:

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **مقاعد تغير أصحابها.** إذا تم إلقاء خريطة واستبدالها، فقد تصبح بعض الدوائر أكثر أو أقل ملاءمة لحزب معين.

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **قرارات المرشحين.** يقرر شاغلو المناصب والمتحدون ما إذا كانوا سيترشحون وأين، بناءً على الدائرة التي سيمثلونها.

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: 3. **جمع التبرعات والاهتمام.** توجيه المجموعات الوطنية الأموال والمتطوعين إلى الدوائر التي تراها تنافسية. يمكن لخريطة جديدة نقل أو إزالة تلك الأهداف.

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **ارتباك الناخبين.** قد يجد الناخبون أنفسهم في دائرة جديدة مع مرشحين مختلفين، وقد لا يتعلمون ذلك إلا في وقت متأخر من الدورة.

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: لا يمكن لأحد التنبؤ بدقة بكيفية أداء خريطة جديدة.

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: نسب الإقبال، جودة المرشحين، المزاج الوطني، والاقتصاد كلها تؤثر على النتائج.

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: الخريطة هي نقطة بداية وليست ضمانة.

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## لماذا يجب على الناخبين الاهتمام

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: قد تبدو إعادة تقسيم الدوائر تقنية، لكنها تشكل بعض الأجزاء الأساسية للتمثيل:

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.
segments.tr: - **من يمثلك.** تحدد دائرتك عضو الكونغرس الذي تصوت له ومن يتعامل مع ملفات قضاياك، مثل المساعدة في الوكالات الفيدرالية.

segments.src: - **How competitive your elections are.** In a very safe district, the general election may matter less than the primary.
segments.tr: - **مدى تنافسية انتخاباتك.** في دائرة آمنة للغاية، قد تكون الانتخابات العامة أقل أهمية من الانتخابات التمهيدية.

segments.src: - **Whether communities stay together.** Lines can keep a town, county, or region whole, or divide it among several districts.
segments.tr: - **ما إذا كانت المجتمعات تبقى معاً.** يمكن للحدود أن تبقي بلدة أو مقاطعة أو منطقة بأكملها، أو تقسمها بين عدة دوائر.

segments.src: - **Confidence in elections.** Fights over maps can affect how much people trust the process, whatever their politics.
segments.tr: - **الثقة في الانتخابات.** يمكن أن تؤثر المعارك حول الخرائط على مدى ثقة الناس في العملية، بغض النظر عن سياساتهم.

segments.src: ## What You Can Do
segments.tr: ## ما يمكنك القيام به

segments.src: - **Check your district.** Use your state election office's website or a nonpartisan voter guide to confirm your current district before every election. It may have changed.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من دائرتك.** استخدم موقع مكتب الانتخابات في ولايتك أو دليلاً غير حزبي للناخبين لتأكيد دائرتك الحالية قبل كل انتخاب. ربما تكون قد تغيرت.

segments.src: - **Verify your registration.** Confirm your registration, polling place, and deadlines with your state or local election office.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من تسجيلك.** أكد تسجيلك ومكان التصويت والمواعيد النهائية مع مكتب الانتخابات في ولايتك أو محليتك.

segments.src: - **Follow reliable sources.** Look for coverage from established news outlets and nonpartisan organizations that track redistricting litigation. Court dockets and official state sites are the most direct sources.
segments.tr: - **اتبع مصادر موثوقة.** ابحث عن تغطية من منافذ إخبارية راسخة ومنظمات غير حزبية تتابع تقاضي إعادة تقسيم الدوائر. تعتبر سجلات المحاكم ومواقع الولاية الرسمية هي المصادر الأكثر مباشرة.

segments.src: - **Take part in public processes.** Many states hold hearings or accept public comments on proposed maps. Showing up or submitting comments is one direct way to be heard.
segments.tr: - **شارك في العمليات العامة.** تعقد العديد من الولايات جلسات استماع أو تقبل تعليقات عامة على الخرائط المقترحة. الحضور أو تقديم التعليقات هو إحدى الطرق المباشرة ليتم سماعك.

segments.src: - **Vote in every election.** Primaries and local races often decide who has power over later redistricting decisions.
segments.tr: - **صوت في كل انتخابات.** غالباً ما تقرر الانتخابات التمهيدية والسباقات المحلية من يملك السلطة على قرارات إعادة تقسيم الدوائر اللاحقة.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Mid-decade redistricting fights show how much depends on the details of how lines are drawn and who gets to decide.
segments.tr: تظهر صراعات إعادة تقسيم الدوائر في منتصف العقد مدى ما يعتمد على تفاصيل كيف يتم رسم الخطوط ومن يحصل على القرار.

segments.src: Courts at the state and federal level are now weighing which maps will stand, and their rulings can affect which party controls the House.
segments.tr: تدرس المحاكم على مستوى الولاية والمستوى الفيدرالي الآن أي الخرائط ستصمد، ويمكن أن تؤثر أحكامها على الحزب الذي يسيطر على مجلس النواب.

segments.src: Voters of all views are best served by knowing their district, checking the rules before they vote, and relying on trustworthy sources while the legal picture keeps changing.
segments.tr: يتم خدمة الناخبين من جميع وجهات النظر بشكل أفضل بمعرفة دائرتهم، والتحقق من القواعد قبل التصويت، والاعتماد على مصادر جديرة بالثقة بينما تستمر الصورة القانونية في التغير.

segments.tr: *هذه المقالة لأغراض معلوماتية عامة ولا تؤيد أي حزب أو مرشح أو خريطة.

segments.src: Redistricting law and litigation change quickly, so check official state election websites and reliable news sources for current information.*
segments.tr: قانون إعادة تقسيم الدوائر والتقاضي يتغيران بسرعة، لذا تحقق من مواقع الانتخابات الرسمية للولاية والمصادر الإخبارية الموثوقة للحصول على معلومات حالية.*

fr.title: Cartes redessinées, probabilités remises en jeu : comment les luttes de redécoupage électoral en cours de décennie façonnent la course à la Chambre

segments.src: Congressional district lines are supposed to be redrawn once a decade, after the census.
segments.tr: Les limites des circonscriptions électorales sont censées être redessinées une fois par décennie, après le recensement.

segments.src: In recent years, though, several states have gone back to the map between census years.
segments.tr: Ces dernières années, cependant, plusieurs États sont revenus sur leur carte entre deux recensements.

segments.src: Lawsuits and court rulings now decide which of those maps voters will actually use.
segments.tr: Poursuites judiciaires et décisions de justice déterminent désormais laquelle de ces cartes les électeurs utiliseront réellement.

segments.src: In a closely divided House, even a few districts can change who holds the majority.
segments.tr: Dans une Chambre très divisée, quelques circonscriptions seulement peuvent changer le parti qui détient la majorité.

segments.src: This explainer covers what mid-decade redistricting is, why it matters, how courts are involved, and what voters can do to stay informed.
segments.tr: Ce document explicatif aborde ce qu'est le redécoupage en cours de décennie, pourquoi il importe, comment les tribunaux y sont impliqués et ce que les électeurs peuvent faire pour rester informés.

segments.src: ## What Is Redistricting, and Why Does It Happen Mid-Decade?
segments.tr: ## Qu'est-ce que le redécoupage électoral et pourquoi a-t-il lieu en cours de décennie ?

segments.src: Every ten years the U.S.
segments.tr: Tous les dix ans, le recensement des États-Unis

segments.src: Census counts the population.
segments.tr: compte la population.

segments.src: States then use the results to divide their territory into congressional districts of roughly equal population.
segments.tr: Les États utilisent ensuite les résultats pour diviser leur territoire en circonscriptions électorales de population approximativement égale.

segments.src: That process is called redistricting.
segments.tr: Ce processus est appelé le redécoupage électoral.

segments.src: Redistricting normally happens once per cycle.
segments.tr: Le redécoupage a normalement lieu une fois par cycle.

segments.src: A map can be redrawn sooner for several reasons:
segments.tr: Une carte peut être redessinée plus tôt pour plusieurs raisons :

segments.src: - **A court strikes down an existing map.** A judge may find that a map violates the U.S. Constitution, the Voting Rights Act, or a state constitution. The state must then adopt a replacement.
segments.tr: - **Un tribunal annule une carte existante.** Un juge peut estimer qu'une carte viole la Constitution des États-Unis, le Voting Rights Act ou la constitution d'un État. L'État doit alors en adopter une de remplacement.

segments.src: - **A legislature chooses to redraw.** In many states, lawmakers can pass a new map at any time unless state law says otherwise.
segments.tr: - **Une législature choisit de redécouper.** Dans de nombreux États, les législateurs peuvent adopter une nouvelle carte à tout moment, sauf si la loi de l'État dispose du contraire.

segments.src: - **A state's rules change.** A ballot measure, a new state court interpretation, or a change in a state's redistricting commission can all prompt a new map.
segments.tr: - **Les règles d'un État changent.** Une initiative populaire, une nouvelle interprétation par un tribunal d'État ou un changement au sein de la commission de redécoupage d'un État peuvent tous entraîner une nouvelle carte.

segments.src: - **A competing state responds.** When one state redraws, officials in other states sometimes weigh whether to do the same.
segments.tr: - **Un État concurrent réagit.** Lorsqu'un État redessine sa carte, les responsables d'autres États évaluent parfois s'il convient de faire de même.

segments.src: Each state follows its own rules.
segments.tr: Chaque État suit ses propres règles.

segments.src: Some give the legislature the main role.
segments.tr: Certains donnent le rôle principal à la législature.

segments.src: Others use independent or bipartisan commissions.
segments.tr: D'autres utilisent des commissions indépendantes ou bipartites.

segments.src: Still others split the work between the two.
segments.tr: D'autres encore partagent le travail entre les deux.

segments.src: ## Why Small Changes Can Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi de petits changements peuvent avoir tant d'importance

segments.src: The House has 435 voting seats, and control often comes down to a handful of them.
segments.tr: La Chambre compte 435 sièges avec droit de vote, et le contrôle se joue souvent à une poignée d'entre eux.

segments.src: Recent majorities have been narrow, so shifting even a few competitive districts can change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: Les majorités récentes ont été étroites, si bien que le basculement de quelques circonscriptions disputées seulement peut changer le parti qui contrôle la chambre.

segments.src: Mapmakers have a few common tools:
segments.tr: Les concepteurs de cartes disposent de quelques outils courants :

segments.src: - **"Packing"** puts many of one group's voters into a single district. That group wins that seat by a wide margin, and its voting strength is smaller in neighboring districts.
segments.tr: - **Le « packing » (rassemblement)** consiste à regrouper un grand nombre d'électeurs d'un même groupe dans une seule circonscription. Ce groupe remporte ce siège avec une large avance, mais sa force électorale s'en trouve réduite dans les circonscriptions voisines.

segments.src: - **"Cracking"** splits a group's voters across several districts. In each one the group may be too small to win.
segments.tr: - **Le « cracking » (dispersion)** divise les électeurs d'un groupe à travers plusieurs circonscriptions. Dans chacune d'elles, le groupe peut être trop restreint pour l'emporter.

segments.src: - **Adjusting competitive districts.** Moving a few neighborhoods or counties can turn a toss-up seat into a safer one for either side.
segments.tr: - **L'ajustement des circonscriptions disputées.** Déplacer quelques quartiers ou comtés peut transformer un siège indécis en un siège plus sûr pour l'un ou l'autre camp.

segments.src: These techniques are lawful in some forms and unlawful in others.
segments.tr: Ces techniques sont légales sous certaines formes et illégales sous d'autres.

segments.src: Courts are often asked to draw that line.
segments.tr: Il est souvent demandé aux tribunaux de tracer cette limite.

segments.src: ## The Role of the Courts
segments.tr: ## Le rôle des tribunaux

segments.src: Several kinds of legal questions come up in redistricting cases.
segments.tr: Plusieurs types de questions juridiques se posent dans les affaires de redécoupage électoral.

segments.src: **Federal law.** Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act bars maps that dilute the voting power of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: **Le droit fédéral.** L'article 2 du Voting Rights Act interdit les cartes qui diluent le pouvoir électoral des groupes minoritaires raciaux ou linguistiques.

segments.src: The Equal Protection Clause also limits how much race may be used when drawing lines.
segments.tr: La clause d'égale protection (Equal Protection Clause) limite également la manière dont la race peut être prise en compte lors du tracé des lignes.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has handled many cases on how these rules apply, and its decisions shape what lower courts do.
segments.tr: La Cour suprême a traité de nombreuses affaires sur l'application de ces règles, et ses décisions façonnent ce que font les juridictions inférieures.

segments.src: **Partisan gerrymandering.** In 2019, the Supreme Court held in *Rucho v.
segments.tr: **Le charcutage électoral partisan (gerrymandering).** En 2019, la Cour suprême a estimé dans l'affaire *Rucho v.

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause* que les tribunaux fédéraux ne peuvent pas trancher les contestations affirmant qu'une carte est trop partisane.

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: La Cour a déclaré que ces litiges sont des questions politiques hors de portée du pouvoir judiciaire fédéral.

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: Cette décision a laissé les contestations aux tribunaux d'État et au droit des États.

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **Les constitutions des États.** De nombreuses constitutions d'États incluent des clauses d'« élections libres et équitables » ou des normes spécifiques pour le redécoupage, telles que la compacité ou le maintien de l'unité des communautés.

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: Les cours suprêmes de plusieurs États ont utilisé ces dispositions pour examiner et, dans certains cas, rejeter des cartes électorales pour la Chambre des représentants.

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **Le calendrier.** Le calendrier électoral compte.

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: Les tribunaux examinent souvent si le fait de modifier une carte à l'approche d'une élection induirait les électeurs en erreur ou chargerait trop les responsables électoraux.

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: Les juges autorisent parfois le maintien d'une carte contestée pour une élection pendant que l'affaire se poursuit.

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: En raison de ces différents niveaux, une carte peut être annulée par un tribunal, rétablie par un autre, puis examinée à nouveau.

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: Les décisions peuvent intervenir à l'approche des dates limites de dépôt des candidatures ou des primaires.

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## Comment les décisions de justice peuvent modifier l'équilibre des pouvoirs

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: Une décision de justice peut affecter la Chambre de plusieurs manières :

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **Les sièges qui changent de mains.** Si une carte est rejetée et remplacée, certaines circonscriptions peuvent devenir plus ou moins favorables à un parti donné.

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **Les décisions des candidats.** Les élus sortants et les candidats challengers décident de se présenter ou non, et où, en fonction de la circonscription qu'ils représenteraient.

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: 3. **La collecte de fonds et l'attention.** Les groupes nationaux orientent l'argent et les bénévoles vers les circonscriptions qu'ils jugent disputées. Une nouvelle carte peut déplacer ou supprimer ces cibles.

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **La confusion des électeurs.** Les électeurs peuvent se retrouver dans une nouvelle circonscription avec des candidats différents, et ne pas l'apprendre avant une étape tardive du cycle.

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: Personne ne peut prédire exactement comment une nouvelle carte fonctionnera.

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: Le taux de participation, la qualité des candidats, le climat national et l'économie affectent tous les résultats.

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: Une carte est un point de départ, pas une garantie.

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les électeurs devraient s'en soucier

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: Le redécoupage électoral peut sembler technique, mais il façonne certains aspects fondamentaux de la représentation :

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.
segments.tr: - **Qui vous représente.** Votre circonscription détermine pour quel membre du Congrès vous votez et qui traite vos dossiers individuels, comme l'aide auprès des agences fédérales.

segments.src: - **How competitive your elections are.** In a very safe district, the general election may matter less than the primary.
segments.tr: - **Le niveau de compétition de vos élections.** Dans une circonscription très sûre, l'élection générale peut avoir moins d'importance que la primaire.

segments.src: - **Whether communities stay together.** Lines can keep a town, county, or region whole, or divide it among several districts.
segments.tr: - **Le maintien de l'unité des communautés.** Les lignes peuvent préserver l'unité d'une ville, d'un comté ou d'une région, ou la diviser entre plusieurs circonscriptions.

segments.src: - **Confidence in elections.** Fights over maps can affect how much people trust the process, whatever their politics.
segments.tr: - **La confiance dans les élections.** Les luttes autour des cartes peuvent affecter le niveau de confiance des gens dans le processus, quelles que soient leurs opinions politiques.

segments.src: ## What You Can Do
segments.tr: ## Ce que vous pouvez faire
