pt.title: Mapas Redesenhados, Probabilidades Redesenhadas: Como as Disputas de Redistritamento no Meio da Década Estão Moldando a Corrida para a Câmara

segments.src: Congressional district lines are supposed to be redrawn once a decade, after the census.
segments.tr: As linhas dos distritos congressuais devem ser redesenhadas uma vez por década, após o censo.

segments.src: In recent years, though, several states have gone back to the map between census years.
segments.tr: Nos últimos anos, porém, vários estados voltaram a mexer no mapa entre os anos censitários.

segments.src: Lawsuits and court rulings now decide which of those maps voters will actually use.
segments.tr: Ações judiciais e decisões judiciais agora decidem quais desses mapas os eleitores realmente usarão.

segments.src: In a closely divided House, even a few districts can change who holds the majority.
segments.tr: Em uma Câmara dividida por margens estreitas, até mesmo alguns distritos podem mudar quem detém a maioria.

segments.src: This explainer covers what mid-decade redistricting is, why it matters, how courts are involved, and what voters can do to stay informed.
segments.tr: Este guia explicativo aborda o que é o redistritamento no meio da década, por que ele importa, como os tribunais estão envolvidos e o que os eleitores podem fazer para se manterem informados.

segments.src: ## What Is Redistricting, and Why Does It Happen Mid-Decade?
segments.tr: ## O Que É Redistritamento e Por Que Ele Acontece no Meio da Década?

segments.src: Every ten years the U.S.
segments.tr: A cada dez anos, o censo dos EUA

segments.src: Census counts the population.
segments.tr: conta a população.

segments.src: States then use the results to divide their territory into congressional districts of roughly equal population.
segments.tr: Os estados então usam os resultados para dividir seu território em distritos congressuais de população aproximadamente igual.

segments.src: That process is called redistricting.
segments.tr: Esse processo é chamado de redistritamento.

segments.src: Redistricting normally happens once per cycle.
segments.tr: O redistritamento normalmente acontece uma vez por ciclo.

segments.src: A map can be redrawn sooner for several reasons:
segments.tr: Um mapa pode ser redesenhado antes por vários motivos:

segments.src: - **A court strikes down an existing map.** A judge may find that a map violates the U.S. Constitution, the Voting Rights Act, or a state constitution. The state must then adopt a replacement.
segments.tr: - **Um tribunal derruba um mapa existente.** Um juiz pode considerar que um mapa viola a Constituição dos EUA, a Lei de Direitos de Voto ou uma constituição estadual. O estado deve então adotar um substituto.

segments.src: - **A legislature chooses to redraw.** In many states, lawmakers can pass a new map at any time unless state law says otherwise.
segments.tr: - **Uma legislatura escolhe redesenhar.** Em muitos estados, os legisladores podem aprovar um novo mapa a qualquer momento, a menos que a lei estadual diga o contrário.

segments.src: - **A state's rules change.** A ballot measure, a new state court interpretation, or a change in a state's redistricting commission can all prompt a new map.
segments.tr: - **As regras de um estado mudam.** Uma medida de votação, uma nova interpretação de um tribunal estadual ou uma mudança na comissão de redistritamento de um estado podem motivar um novo mapa.

segments.src: - **A competing state responds.** When one state redraws, officials in other states sometimes weigh whether to do the same.
segments.tr: - **Um estado concorrente responde.** Quando um estado redesenha seus mapas, autoridades em outros estados às vezes avaliam se devem fazer o mesmo.

segments.src: Each state follows its own rules.
segments.tr: Cada estado segue suas próprias regras.

segments.src: Some give the legislature the main role.
segments.tr: Alguns dão à legislatura o papel principal.

segments.src: Others use independent or bipartisan commissions.
segments.tr: Outros usam comissões independentes ou bipartidárias.

segments.src: Still others split the work between the two.
segments.tr: Ainda outros dividem o trabalho entre os dois.

segments.src: ## Why Small Changes Can Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## Por Que Pequenas Mudanças Podem Importar Tanto

segments.src: The House has 435 voting seats, and control often comes down to a handful of them.
segments.tr: A Câmara tem 435 assentos com direito a voto, e o controle muitas vezes se resume a um punhado deles.

segments.src: Recent majorities have been narrow, so shifting even a few competitive districts can change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: As maiorias recentes têm sido estreitas, portanto, mudar até mesmo alguns distritos competitivos pode alterar qual partido controla a câmara.

segments.src: Mapmakers have a few common tools:
segments.tr: Os criadores de mapas têm algumas ferramentas comuns:

segments.src: - **"Packing"** puts many of one group's voters into a single district. That group wins that seat by a wide margin, and its voting strength is smaller in neighboring districts.
segments.tr: - **"Packing" (Concentração)** coloca muitos eleitores de um grupo em um único distrito. Esse grupo vence esse assento por uma margem ampla, e sua força de voto é menor nos distritos vizinhos.

segments.src: - **"Cracking"** splits a group's voters across several districts. In each one the group may be too small to win.
segments.tr: - **"Cracking" (Fragmentação)** divide os eleitores de um grupo em vários distritos. Em cada um deles, o grupo pode ser pequeno demais para vencer.

segments.src: - **Adjusting competitive districts.** Moving a few neighborhoods or counties can turn a toss-up seat into a safer one for either side.
segments.tr: - **Ajustar distritos competitivos.** Mover alguns bairros ou condados pode transformar um assento indefinido em um mais seguro para qualquer um dos lados.

segments.src: These techniques are lawful in some forms and unlawful in others.
segments.tr: Essas técnicas são legais de certas formas e ilegais em outras.

segments.src: Courts are often asked to draw that line.
segments.tr: Os tribunais são frequentemente solicitados a traçar essa linha.

segments.src: ## The Role of the Courts
segments.tr: ## O Papel dos Tribunais

segments.src: Several kinds of legal questions come up in redistricting cases.
segments.tr: Vários tipos de questões jurídicas surgem em casos de redistritamento.

segments.src: **Federal law.** Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act bars maps that dilute the voting power of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: **Lei federal.** A Seção 2 da Lei de Direitos de Voto proíbe mapas que diluem o poder de voto de grupos minoritários raciais ou linguísticos.

segments.src: The Equal Protection Clause also limits how much race may be used when drawing lines.
segments.tr: A Cláusula de Igual Proteção também limita o quanto a raça pode ser usada ao traçar linhas.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has handled many cases on how these rules apply, and its decisions shape what lower courts do.
segments.tr: A Suprema Corte lidou com muitos casos sobre como essas regras se aplicam, e suas decisões moldam o que os tribunais inferiores fazem.

segments.src: **Partisan gerrymandering.** In 2019, the Supreme Court held in *Rucho v.
segments.tr: **Gerrymandering partidário.** Em 2019, a Suprema Corte decidiu em *Rucho v.

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause* que os tribunais federais não podem decidir alegações de que um mapa é partidário demais.

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: A Corte afirmou que essas disputas são questões políticas fora do alcance do poder judiciário federal.

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: A decisão deixou os recursos para os tribunais estaduais e a lei estadual.

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **Constituições estaduais.** Muitas constituições estaduais incluem cláusulas de "eleições livres e justas" ou padrões específicos para o redistritamento, como compacidade ou manter as comunidades juntas.

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: Supremas Cortes estaduais em vários estados usaram essas disposições para revisar e, em alguns casos, rejeitar mapas congressuais.

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **Cronograma.** Os calendários eleitorais importam.

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: Os tribunais frequentemente consideram se a alteração de um mapa perto de uma eleição confundiria os eleitores ou sobrecarregaria os oficiais eleitorais.

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: Os juízes às vezes permitem que um mapa contestado permaneça em vigor para uma eleição enquanto o caso continua.

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: Devido a essas camadas, um mapa pode ser derrubado em um tribunal, restaurado por outro e depois revisado novamente.

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: As decisões podem chegar perto dos prazos de registro ou das primárias.

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## Como as Decisões Podem Mudar o Equilíbrio de Poder

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: Uma decisão judicial pode afetar a Câmara de várias maneiras:

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **Assentos que mudam de mãos.** Se um mapa for descartado e substituído, alguns distritos podem se tornar mais ou menos favoráveis a um determinado partido.

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **Decisões de candidatos.** Titulares de cargos e desafiantes decidem se devem concorrer, e onde, com base no distrito que representariam.

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: 3. **Arrecadação de fundos e atenção.** Grupos nacionais direcionam dinheiro e voluntários para distritos que consideram competitivos. Um novo mapa pode mover ou remover esses alvos.

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **Confusão dos eleitores.** Os eleitores podem se ver em um novo distrito com candidatos diferentes e podem não saber disso até o final do ciclo.

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: Ninguém pode prever exatamente como um novo mapa funcionará.

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: A participação eleitoral, a qualidade dos candidatos, o clima nacional e a economia afetam os resultados.

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: Um mapa é um ponto de partida, não uma garantia.

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## Por Que os Eleitores Devem Se Importar

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: O redistritamento pode parecer técnico, mas molda alguns aspectos básicos da representação:

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.
segments.tr: - **Quem representa você.** Seu distrito determina para qual membro do Congresso você vota e quem lida com seus casos, como ajuda com agências federais.

segments.src: - **How competitive your elections are.** In a very safe district, the general election may matter less than the primary.
segments.tr: - **Quão competitivas são suas eleições.** Em um distrito muito seguro, a eleição geral pode importar menos do que a primária.

segments.src: - **Whether communities stay together.** Lines can keep a town, county, or region whole, or divide it among several districts.
segments.tr: - **Se as comunidades ficam juntas.** As linhas podem manter uma cidade, condado ou região inteira, ou dividi-la entre vários distritos.

segments.src: - **Confidence in elections.** Fights over maps can affect how much people trust the process, whatever their politics.
segments.tr: - **Confiança nas eleições.** As lutas sobre mapas podem afetar o quanto as pessoas confiam no processo, independentemente de suas opiniões políticas.

segments.src: ## What You Can Do
segments.tr: ## O Que Você Pode Fazer

segments.src: - **Check your district.** Use your state election office's website or a nonpartisan voter guide to confirm your current district before every election. It may have changed.
segments.tr: - **Verifique seu distrito.** Use o site do escritório eleitoral do seu estado ou um guia eleitoral não partidário para confirmar seu distrito atual antes de cada eleição. Ele pode ter mudado.

segments.src: - **Verify your registration.** Confirm your registration, polling place, and deadlines with your state or local election office.
segments.tr: - **Verifique seu registro.** Confirme seu registro, local de votação e prazos com o escritório eleitoral estadual ou local.

segments.src: - **Follow reliable sources.** Look for coverage from established news outlets and nonpartisan organizations that track redistricting litigation. Court dockets and official state sites are the most direct sources.
segments.tr: - **Siga fontes confiáveis.** Procure cobertura de veículos de imprensa estabelecidos e organizações não partidárias que acompanham litígios de redistritamento. Os registros judiciais e os sites oficiais do estado são as fontes mais diretas.

segments.src: - **Take part in public processes.** Many states hold hearings or accept public comments on proposed maps. Showing up or submitting comments is one direct way to be heard.
segments.tr: - **Participe de processos públicos.** Muitos estados realizam audiências ou aceitam comentários públicos sobre mapas propostos. Comparecer ou enviar comentários é uma forma direta de ser ouvido.

segments.src: - **Vote in every election.** Primaries and local races often decide who has power over later redistricting decisions.
segments.tr: - **Vote em todas as eleições.** As primárias e as corridas locais geralmente decidem quem tem poder sobre futuras decisões de redistritamento.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## A Conclusão

segments.src: Mid-decade redistricting fights show how much depends on the details of how lines are drawn and who gets to decide.
segments.tr: As disputas de redistritamento no meio da década mostram o quanto depende dos detalhes de como as linhas são desenhadas e de quem decide.

segments.src: Courts at the state and federal level are now weighing which maps will stand, and their rulings can affect which party controls the House.
segments.tr: Os tribunais estaduais e federais estão agora avaliando quais mapas prevalecerão, e suas decisões podem afetar qual partido controla a Câmara.

segments.src: Voters of all views are best served by knowing their district, checking the rules before they vote, and relying on trustworthy sources while the legal picture keeps changing.
segments.tr: Eleitores de todas as visões são melhor atendidos conhecendo seu distrito, verificando as regras antes de votar e confiando em fontes confiáveis enquanto o cenário jurídico continua mudando.

segments.src: ## What Is Redistricting, and Why Does It Happen Mid-Decade?
segments.tr: ## Apa Itu Penataan Ulang Distrik, dan Mengapa Hal Itu Terjadi di Pertengahan Dekade?

segments.src: Every ten years the U.S.

segments.src: Census counts the population.
segments.tr: Sensus menghitung jumlah penduduk.

segments.src: States then use the results to divide their territory into congressional districts of roughly equal population.
segments.tr: Negara-negara bagian kemudian menggunakan hasilnya untuk membagi wilayah mereka menjadi distrik-distrik kongres dengan jumlah penduduk yang hampir sama.

segments.src: That process is called redistricting.
segments.tr: Proses tersebut disebut penataan ulang distrik.

segments.src: Redistricting normally happens once per cycle.
segments.tr: Penataan ulang distrik biasanya terjadi sekali dalam setiap siklus.

segments.src: A map can be redrawn sooner for several reasons:
segments.tr: Sebuah peta dapat digambar ulang lebih cepat karena beberapa alasan:

segments.src: - **A court strikes down an existing map.** A judge may find that a map violates the U.S. Constitution, the Voting Rights Act, or a state constitution. The state must then adopt a replacement.
segments.tr: - **Pengadilan membatalkan peta yang ada.** Seorang hakim dapat memutuskan bahwa suatu peta melanggar Konstitusi AS, Undang-Undang Hak Suara, atau konstitusi negara bagian. Negara bagian tersebut kemudian harus mengadopsi peta pengganti.

segments.src: - **A legislature chooses to redraw.** In many states, lawmakers can pass a new map at any time unless state law says otherwise.
segments.tr: - **Badan legislatif memilih untuk menggambar ulang.** Di banyak negara bagian, para pembuat undang-undang dapat mengesahkan peta baru kapan saja kecuali undang-undang negara bagian menyatakan sebaliknya.

segments.src: - **A state's rules change.** A ballot measure, a new state court interpretation, or a change in a state's redistricting commission can all prompt a new map.
segments.tr: - **Aturan negara bagian berubah.** Langkah pemungutan suara, interpretasi pengadilan negara bagian yang baru, atau perubahan pada komisi penataan ulang distrik di suatu negara bagian semuanya dapat memicu peta baru.

segments.src: - **A competing state responds.** When one state redraws, officials in other states sometimes weigh whether to do the same.
segments.tr: - **Negara bagian yang bersaing merespons.** Ketika satu negara bagian menggambar ulang petanya, pejabat di negara bagian lain terkadang mempertimbangkan untuk melakukan hal yang sama.

segments.src: Each state follows its own rules.
segments.tr: Setiap negara bagian mengikuti aturannya sendiri.

segments.src: Some give the legislature the main role.
segments.tr: Beberapa memberikan peran utama kepada badan legislatif.

segments.src: Others use independent or bipartisan commissions.
segments.tr: Yang lain menggunakan komisi independen atau bipartisan.

segments.src: Still others split the work between the two.
segments.tr: Ada pula yang membagi tugas di antara keduanya.

segments.src: ## Why Small Changes Can Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Perubahan Kecil Bisa Begitu Penting

segments.src: The House has 435 voting seats, and control often comes down to a handful of them.
segments.tr: DPR memiliki 435 kursi suara, dan kendali sering kali ditentukan oleh segelintir kursi saja.

segments.src: Recent majorities have been narrow, so shifting even a few competitive districts can change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: Mayoritas dalam beberapa tahun terakhir sangat tipis, sehingga menggeser beberapa distrik kompetitif saja dapat mengubah partai mana yang mengontrol majelis.

segments.src: Mapmakers have a few common tools:
segments.tr: Para pembuat peta memiliki beberapa alat umum:

segments.src: - **"Packing"** puts many of one group's voters into a single district. That group wins that seat by a wide margin, and its voting strength is smaller in neighboring districts.
segments.tr: - **"Packing" (Pengemasan)** menempatkan banyak pemilih dari satu kelompok ke dalam satu distrik tunggal. Kelompok tersebut memenangkan kursi itu dengan selisih suara yang besar, dan kekuatan suara mereka menjadi lebih kecil di distrik-distrik tetangga.

segments.src: - **"Cracking"** splits a group's voters across several districts. In each one the group may be too small to win.
segments.tr: - **"Cracking" (Pemecahan)** memecah pemilih suatu kelompok ke beberapa distrik. Di setiap distrik, kelompok tersebut mungkin terlalu kecil untuk menang.

segments.src: - **Adjusting competitive districts.** Moving a few neighborhoods or counties can turn a toss-up seat into a safer one for either side.
segments.tr: - **Menyesuaikan distrik kompetitif.** Memindahkan beberapa lingkungan atau kabupaten dapat mengubah kursi yang diperebutkan dengan ketat menjadi kursi yang lebih aman bagi pihak manapun.

segments.src: These techniques are lawful in some forms and unlawful in others.
segments.tr: Teknik-teknik ini sah dalam beberapa bentuk dan melanggar hukum dalam bentuk lainnya.

segments.src: Courts are often asked to draw that line.
segments.tr: Pengadilan sering kali diminta untuk menarik garis batas tersebut.

segments.src: ## The Role of the Courts
segments.tr: ## Peran Pengadilan

segments.src: Several kinds of legal questions come up in redistricting cases.
segments.tr: Beberapa jenis pertanyaan hukum muncul dalam kasus penataan ulang distrik.

segments.src: **Federal law.** Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act bars maps that dilute the voting power of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: **Hukum federal.** Bagian 2 dari Undang-Undang Hak Suara melarang peta yang melemahkan kekuatan suara kelompok minoritas ras atau bahasa.

segments.src: The Equal Protection Clause also limits how much race may be used when drawing lines.
segments.tr: Klausul Perlindungan Setara juga membatasi seberapa besar unsur ras dapat digunakan saat menggambar batas wilayah.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has handled many cases on how these rules apply, and its decisions shape what lower courts do.
segments.tr: Mahkamah Agung telah menangani banyak kasus tentang bagaimana aturan-aturan ini diterapkan, dan keputusan-keputusannya membentuk tindakan pengadilan yang lebih rendah.

segments.src: **Partisan gerrymandering.** In 2019, the Supreme Court held in *Rucho v.
segments.tr: **Gerrymandering partisan.** Pada tahun 2019, Mahkamah Agung memutuskan dalam perkara *Rucho v.

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause* bahwa pengadilan federal tidak dapat memutuskan klaim bahwa suatu peta terlalu bersifat partisan.

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: Mahkamah menyatakan bahwa perselisihan tersebut merupakan masalah politik yang berada di luar jangkauan peradilan federal.

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: Keputusan tersebut menyerahkan gugatan kepada pengadilan negara bagian dan hukum negara bagian.

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **Konstitusi negara bagian.** Banyak konstitusi negara bagian menyertakan klausul "pemilu yang bebas dan adil" atau standar khusus untuk penataan ulang distrik, seperti kekompakan atau menjaga komunitas tetap Bersatu.

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: Mahkamah agung di beberapa negara bagian telah menggunakan ketentuan ini untuk meninjau dan, dalam beberapa kasus, menolak peta kongres.

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **Waktu.** Kalender pemilu itu penting.

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: Pengadilan sering kali mempertimbangkan apakah mengubah peta menjelang pemilu akan membingungkan pemilih atau membebani pejabat pemilu.

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: Hakim terkadang mengizinkan peta yang digugat tetap berlaku untuk satu kali pemilu sementara kasus tersebut berlanjut.

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: Karena adanya lapisan-lapisan ini, sebuah peta dapat dibatalkan di satu pengadilan, dipulihkan oleh pengadilan lain, lalu ditinjau kembali.

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: Putusan dapat datang mendekati batas waktu pendaftaran atau pemilihan pendahuluan (primari).

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Putusan Dapat Mengubah Keseimbangan Kekuatan

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: Keputusan pengadilan dapat memengaruhi DPR dalam beberapa cara:

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **Kursi yang berpindah tangan.** Jika sebuah peta dibuang dan diganti, beberapa distrik mungkin menjadi lebih menguntungkan atau kurang menguntungkan bagi partai tertentu.

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **Keputusan kandidat.** Petahana dan penantang memutuskan apakah akan mencalonkan diri, dan di mana, berdasarkan distrik yang akan mereka wakili.

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: **Penggalangan dana dan perhatian.** Kelompok nasional mengarahkan uang dan relawan ke distrik-distrik yang mereka anggap kompetitif. Peta baru dapat memindahkan atau menghapus target tersebut.

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **Kebingungan pemilih.** Pemilih mungkin mendapati diri mereka berada di distrik baru dengan kandidat yang berbeda, dan mungkin tidak mengetahui hal ini sampai akhir siklus.

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: Tidak seorang pun dapat memprediksi secara akurat bagaimana kinerja peta baru.

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: Tingkat partisipasi, kualitas kandidat, suasana nasional, dan perekonomian semuanya memengaruhi hasil.

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: Sebuah peta adalah titik awal, bukan jaminan.

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Pemilih Harus Peduli

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: Penataan ulang distrik mungkin tampak teknis, tetapi hal itu membentuk beberapa bagian dasar dari perwakilan:

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.
segments.tr: - **Siapa yang mewakili Anda.** Distrik Anda menentukan anggota Kongres mana yang Anda pilih dan siapa yang menangani urusan konstituensi Anda, seperti bantuan dengan lembaga federal.

segments.src: - **How competitive your elections are.** In a very safe district, the general election may matter less than the primary.
segments.tr: - **Seberapa kompetitif pemilu Anda.** Di distrik yang sangat aman, pemilu umum mungkin tidak lebih penting daripada pemilu pendahuluan.

segments.src: - **Whether communities stay together.** Lines can keep a town, county, or region whole, or divide it among several districts.
segments.tr: - **Apakah komunitas tetap bersatu.** Garis batas dapat menjaga sebuah kota, kabupaten, atau wilayah tetap utuh, atau membaginya ke dalam beberapa distrik.

segments.src: - **Confidence in elections.** Fights over maps can affect how much people trust the process, whatever their politics.
segments.tr: - **Kepercayaan pada pemilu.** Pertarungan atas peta dapat memengaruhi seberapa besar orang mempercayai proses tersebut, apa pun politik mereka.

segments.src: ## What You Can Do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dapat Anda Lakukan

segments.src: - **Check your district.** Use your state election office's website or a nonpartisan voter guide to confirm your current district before every election. It may have changed.
segments.tr: - **Periksa distrik Anda.** Gunakan situs web kantor pemilu negara bagian Anda atau panduan pemilih nonpartisan untuk mengonfirmasi distrik Anda saat ini sebelum setiap pemilu. Distrik tersebut mungkin telah berubah.

segments.src: - **Verify your registration.** Confirm your registration, polling place, and deadlines with your state or local election office.
segments.tr: - **Verifikasi pendaftaran Anda.** Konfirmasikan pendaftaran, tempat pemungutan suara, dan batas waktu Anda dengan kantor pemilu negara bagian atau lokal Anda.

segments.src: - **Follow reliable sources.** Look for coverage from established news outlets and nonpartisan organizations that track redistricting litigation. Court dockets and official state sites are the most direct sources.
segments.tr: - **Ikuti sumber yang tepercaya.** Cari liputan dari kantor berita terkemuka dan organisasi nonpartisan yang melacak litigasi penataan ulang distrik. Catatan pengadilan dan situs resmi negara bagian adalah sumber yang paling langsung.

segments.src: - **Take part in public processes.** Many states hold hearings or accept public comments on proposed maps. Showing up or submitting comments is one direct way to be heard.
segments.tr: - **Ikut serta dalam proses publik.** Banyak negara bagian mengadakan dengar pendapat atau menerima komentar publik tentang usulan peta. Hadir atau mengirimkan komentar adalah salah satu cara langsung untuk didengar.

segments.src: - **Vote in every election.** Primaries and local races often decide who has power over later redistricting decisions.
segments.tr: - **Memilih dalam setiap pemilu.** Pemilu pendahuluan dan ras lokal sering kali menentukan siapa yang memiliki kekuasaan atas keputusan penataan ulang distrik selanjutnya.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: Mid-decade redistricting fights show how much depends on the details of how lines are drawn and who gets to decide.
segments.tr: Pertarungan penataan ulang distrik pertengahan dekade menunjukkan betapa banyak hal bergantung pada rincian bagaimana garis-garis digambar dan siapa yang berhak memutuskan.

segments.src: Courts at the state and federal level are now weighing which maps will stand, and their rulings can affect which party controls the House.
segments.tr: Pengadilan di tingkat negara bagian dan federal kini sedang menimbang peta mana yang akan bertahan, dan putusan mereka dapat memengaruhi partai mana yang mengontrol DPR.

segments.src: Voters of all views are best served by knowing their district, checking the rules before they vote, and relying on trustworthy sources while the legal picture keeps changing.
segments.tr: Pemilih dari semua pandangan akan dilayani dengan baik dengan mengetahui distrik mereka, memeriksa aturan sebelum mereka memilih, dan mengandalkan sumber-sumber yang tepercaya sementara gambaran hukum terus berubah.

ja.title: 描き直された地図、描き直された確率：中間の十年の区割り変更闘争が下院選挙をどのように形作っているか

segments.src: Congressional district lines are supposed to be redrawn once a decade, after the census.
segments.tr: 連邦下院の選挙区の境界線は、国勢調査の後の10年に1度描き直されることになっている。

segments.src: In recent years, though, several states have gone back to the map between census years.
segments.tr: しかし近年では、国勢調査の年の間に地図を再び作成する州がいくつかある。

segments.src: Lawsuits and court rulings now decide which of those maps voters will actually use.
segments.tr: 現在では、訴訟や裁判所の判決によって、有権者が実際にどの地図を使用することになるかが決まる。

segments.src: In a closely divided House, even a few districts can change who holds the majority.
segments.tr: 勢力が拮抗する下院においては、わずか数個の選挙区でもどちらが多数派を握るかを変える可能性がある。

segments.src: This explainer covers what mid-decade redistricting is, why it matters, how courts are involved, and what voters can do to stay informed.
segments.tr: この解説記事では、十年の中間時点での区割り変更とは何か、なぜそれが重要なのか、裁判所がどのように関わっているのか、そして有権者が情報を把握し続けるために何ができるのかを取り上げる。

segments.src: ## What Is Redistricting, and Why Does It Happen Mid-Decade?
segments.tr: ## 区割り変更とは何か、なぜ十年の中間時点で行われるのか

segments.src: Every ten years the U.S.
segments.tr: 10年ごとに米国は

segments.src: Census counts the population.
segments.tr: 国勢調査を実施して人口を数える。

segments.src: States then use the results to divide their territory into congressional districts of roughly equal population.
segments.tr: その後、州はその結果を利用して、人口がほぼ均等になるように自らの領土を連邦下院の選挙区に分割する。

segments.src: That process is called redistricting.
segments.tr: そのプロセスは区割り変更と呼ばれる。

segments.src: Redistricting normally happens once per cycle.
segments.tr: 区割り変更は通常、1サイクルに1度行われる。

segments.src: A map can be redrawn sooner for several reasons:
segments.tr: いくつかの理由により、地図がより早く描き直されることもある。

segments.src: - **A court strikes down an existing map.** A judge may find that a map violates the U.S. Constitution, the Voting Rights Act, or a state constitution. The state must then adopt a replacement.
segments.tr: - **裁判所が既存の地図を無効とする。** 裁判官は、地図が米国憲法、投票権法、あるいは州憲法に違反していると判断する場合がある。その場合、州は代替の地図を採用しなければならない。

segments.src: - **A legislature chooses to redraw.** In many states, lawmakers can pass a new map at any time unless state law says otherwise.
segments.tr: - **議会が描き直しを選択する。** 多くの州において、州法に別の定めがない限り、議員はいつでも新しい地図を可決することができる。

segments.src: - **A state's rules change.** A ballot measure, a new state court interpretation, or a change in a state's redistricting commission can all prompt a new map.
segments.tr: - **州のルールが変更される。** 住民投票、新しい州の裁判所の解釈、あるいは州の区割り変更委員会の変更などはすべて、新しい地図のきっかけとなり得る。

segments.src: - **A competing state responds.** When one state redraws, officials in other states sometimes weigh whether to do the same.
segments.tr: - **競合する州が対応する。** ある州が地図を描き直すとき、他の州の当局者は同じことを行うべきかどうかを検討することがある。

segments.src: Each state follows its own rules.
segments.tr: 各州は独自のルールに従っている。

segments.src: Some give the legislature the main role.
segments.tr: 議会に主要な役割を与えている州もあれば、

segments.src: Others use independent or bipartisan commissions.
segments.tr: 独立した、または超党派の委員会を利用している州もある。

segments.src: Still others split the work between the two.
segments.tr: また、両者の間で作業を分割している州もある。

segments.src: ## Why Small Changes Can Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## 小さな変更がなぜそれほど重要になり得るのか

segments.src: The House has 435 voting seats, and control often comes down to a handful of them.
segments.tr: 下院には435の投票権を持つ議席があり、支配権はしばしばその中の少数の議席にかかっている。

segments.src: Recent majorities have been narrow, so shifting even a few competitive districts can change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: 近年の多数派は僅差であったため、わずか数個の競合する選挙区を移動させるだけでも、どの政党が議院を支配するかを変える可能性がある。

segments.src: Mapmakers have a few common tools:
segments.tr: 地図作成者はいくつかの一般的なツールを持っている。

segments.src: - **"Packing"** puts many of one group's voters into a single district. That group wins that seat by a wide margin, and its voting strength is smaller in neighboring districts.
segments.tr: - **「パッキング（囲い込み）」**は、あるグループの有権者を多く1つの選挙区に押し込む。そのグループはその議席を大差で獲得するが、隣接する選挙区での投票力は小さくなる。

segments.src: - **"Cracking"** splits a group's voters across several districts. In each one the group may be too small to win.
segments.tr: - **「クラッキング（分割）」**は、あるグループの有権者を複数の選挙区に分散させる。それぞれの選挙区において、そのグループは勝利するには小さすぎるかもしれない。

segments.src: - **Adjusting competitive districts.** Moving a few neighborhoods or counties can turn a toss-up seat into a safer one for either side.
segments.tr: - **競合する選挙区の調整。** 少数の地区や郡を移動させることで、どちらの側にとっても勝敗の予測がつかない議席を、より安全な議席に変えることができる。

segments.src: These techniques are lawful in some forms and unlawful in others.
segments.tr: これらの手法は、ある形態では合法であり、別の形態では違法である。

segments.src: Courts are often asked to draw that line.
segments.tr: 裁判所は、その境界線を引くことを求められることがよくある。

segments.src: ## The Role of the Courts
segments.tr: ## 裁判所の役割

segments.src: Several kinds of legal questions come up in redistricting cases.
segments.tr: 区割り変更の訴訟においては、いくつかの種類の法的問題が生じる。

segments.src: **Federal law.** Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act bars maps that dilute the voting power of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: **連邦法。** 投票権法第2条は、人種的または言語的少数派グループの投票力を薄める地図を禁止している。

segments.src: The Equal Protection Clause also limits how much race may be used when drawing lines.
segments.tr: 平等保護条項もまた、境界線を描く際に人種をどれほど使用できるかを制限している。

segments.src: The Supreme Court has handled many cases on how these rules apply, and its decisions shape what lower courts do.
segments.tr: 最高裁判所は、これらのルールがどのように適用されるかに関して多くの訴訟を処理しており、その決定は下級審の動きを形作っている。

segments.src: **Partisan gerrymandering.** In 2019, the Supreme Court held in *Rucho v.
segments.tr: **党派的なゲリマンダー。** 2019年、最高裁判所は *Rucho v.

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause* 事件において、連邦裁判所は地図が党派的すぎるという主張を裁定することはできないと判示した。

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: 裁判所は、それらの紛争は連邦司法の管轄外の政治的問題であると述べた。

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: この判決により、州裁判所や州法への挑戦が残されることになった。

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **州憲法。** 多くの州憲法には、「自由で公正な選挙」条項や、コンパクトさ（まとまり）やコミュニティを一緒に維持することなどの区割り変更に関する特定の基準が含まれている。

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: いくつかの州の州最高裁判所は、これらの規定を利用して連邦下院の選挙区の地図を審査し、場合によっては却下してきた。

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **タイミング。** 選挙のカレンダーは重要である。

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: 裁判所は、選挙の直前に地図を変更することが有権者を混乱させるか、あるいは選挙当局に負担をかけるかをしばしば考慮する。

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: 裁判官は、訴訟が継続する間、係争中の地図を1度の選挙の間そのまま存続させることを許可することがある。

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: こうしたレイヤーがあるため、ある裁判所で地図が無効とされ、別の裁判所で復活し、さらに再び審査されるということが起こり得る。

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: 判決は、立候補の締め切りや予備選挙の直前に下されることもある。

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## 判決が権力のバランスをどのようにシフトさせるか

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: 裁判所の決定は、いくつかの方法で下院に影響を与える可能性がある。

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **手を変える議席。** 地図が破棄され置き換えられた場合、いくつかの選挙区は特定の政党にとってより有利または不利になる可能性がある。

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **候補者の決定。** 現職および挑戦者は、自分が代表することになる選挙区に基づいて、出馬するかどうか、そしてどこから出馬するかを決定する。

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: 3. **資金集みと注目。** 全国的なグループは、競争が激しいとみなす選挙区に資金やボランティアを向ける。新しい地図はそれらのターゲットを移動させたり削除したりすることができる。

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **有権者の混乱。** 有権者は異なる候補者がいる新しい選挙区に身を置くことになり、サイクルの終盤までそれに気づかないかもしれない。

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: 新しい地図が正確にどのように機能するかを予測できる者は誰もいない。

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: 投票率、候補者の質、国民のムード、そして経済はすべて結果に影響を与える。

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: 地図は出発点であり、保証ではない。

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## 有権者が気にかけるべき理由

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: 区割り変更は技術的なものに見えるかもしれないが、それは代表制のいくつかの基本的な部分を形作っている。

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.

segments.src: Congressional district lines are supposed to be redrawn once a decade, after the census.
segments.tr: Kongresswahlbezirke sollen einmal pro Jahrzehnt nach der Volkszählung neu gezogen werden.

segments.src: In recent years, though, several states have gone back to the map between census years.
segments.tr: In den letzten Jahren sind jedoch mehrere Bundesstaaten zwischen den Volkszählungsjahren zur Landkarte zurückgekehrt.

segments.src: Lawsuits and court rulings now decide which of those maps voters will actually use.
segments.tr: Klagen und Gerichtsentscheidungen bestimmen nun, welche dieser Karten die Wähler tatsächlich nutzen werden.

segments.src: In a closely divided House, even a few districts can change who holds the majority.
segments.tr: In einem knapp geteilten Repräsentantenhaus können selbst wenige Wahlbezirke verändern, wer die Mehrheit innehat.

segments.src: This explainer covers what mid-decade redistricting is, why it matters, how courts are involved, and what voters can do to stay informed.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden erklärt, was eine Neugliederung mitten im Jahrzehnt ist, warum sie wichtig ist, wie Gerichte involviert sind und was Wähler tun können, um informiert zu bleiben.

segments.src: ## What Is Redistricting, and Why Does It Happen Mid-Decade?
segments.tr: ## Was ist eine Neugliederung und warum findet sie mitten im Jahrzehnt statt?

segments.src: Every ten years the U.S.
segments.tr: Alle zehn Jahre zählt die US-amerikanische

segments.src: Census counts the population.
segments.tr: Bevölkerung durch die Volkszählung.

segments.src: States then use the results to divide their territory into congressional districts of roughly equal population.
segments.tr: Die Bundesstaaten nutzen die Ergebnisse dann, um ihr Gebiet in Kongresswahlbezirke von ungefähr gleicher Bevölkerungszahl aufzuteilen.

segments.src: That process is called redistricting.
segments.tr: Dieser Prozess wird als Neugliederung bezeichnet.

segments.src: Redistricting normally happens once per cycle.
segments.tr: Die Neugliederung findet normalerweise einmal pro Zyklus statt.

segments.src: A map can be redrawn sooner for several reasons:
segments.tr: Eine Karte kann aus mehreren Gründen früher neu gezogen werden:

segments.src: - **A court strikes down an existing map.** A judge may find that a map violates the U.S. Constitution, the Voting Rights Act, or a state constitution. The state must then adopt a replacement.
segments.tr: - **Ein Gericht erklärt eine bestehende Karte für ungültig.** Ein Richter kann feststellen, dass eine Karte gegen die US-Verfassung, den Voting Rights Act oder eine Landesverfassung verstößt. Der Bundesstaat muss daraufhin einen Ersatz annehmen.

segments.src: - **A legislature chooses to redraw.** In many states, lawmakers can pass a new map at any time unless state law says otherwise.
segments.tr: - **Ein Parlament beschließt eine Neugliederung.** In vielen Bundesstaaten können Gesetzgeber jederzeit eine neue Karte verabschieden, es sei denn, das Landesrecht besagt etwas anderes.

segments.src: - **A state's rules change.** A ballot measure, a new state court interpretation, or a change in a state's redistricting commission can all prompt a new map.
segments.tr: - **Die Regeln eines Bundesstaates ändern sich.** Eine Volksabstimmung, eine neue Auslegung durch ein Landesgericht oder eine Änderung der Neugliederungskommission eines Bundesstaates können alle eine neue Karte auslösen.

segments.src: - **A competing state responds.** When one state redraws, officials in other states sometimes weigh whether to do the same.
segments.tr: - **Ein konkurrierender Bundesstaat reagiert.** Wenn ein Bundesstaat neu gliedert, wägen Beamte in anderen Bundesstaaten manchmal ab, ob sie dasselbe tun sollten.

segments.src: Each state follows its own rules.
segments.tr: Jeder Bundesstaat folgt seinen eigenen Regeln.

segments.src: Some give the legislature the main role.
segments.tr: Einige übertragen dem Parlament die Hauptrolle.

segments.src: Others use independent or bipartisan commissions.
segments.tr: Andere nutzen unabhängige oder überparteiliche Kommissionen.

segments.src: Still others split the work between the two.
segments.tr: Wieder andere teilen die Arbeit zwischen den beiden auf.

segments.src: ## Why Small Changes Can Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## Warum kleine Änderungen so wichtig sein können

segments.src: The House has 435 voting seats, and control often comes down to a handful of them.
segments.tr: Das Repräsentantenhaus hat 435 stimmberechtigte Sitze, und die Kontrolle hängt oft von einer Handvoll davon ab.

segments.src: Recent majorities have been narrow, so shifting even a few competitive districts can change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: Jüngste Mehrheiten waren knapp, sodass die Verschiebung selbst weniger wettbewerbsintensiver Bezirke verändern kann, welche Partei die Kammer kontrolliert.

segments.src: Mapmakers have a few common tools:
segments.tr: Kartenzeichner haben einige gängige Werkzeuge:

segments.src: - **"Packing"** puts many of one group's voters into a single district. That group wins that seat by a wide margin, and its voting strength is smaller in neighboring districts.
segments.tr: - **„Packing“** packt viele Wähler einer Gruppe in einen einzigen Bezirk. Diese Gruppe gewinnt diesen Sitz mit deutlichem Vorsprung, und ihre Wahlstärke in benachbarten Bezirken ist geringer.

segments.src: - **"Cracking"** splits a group's voters across several districts. In each one the group may be too small to win.
segments.tr: - **„Cracking“** teilt die Wähler einer Gruppe auf mehrere Bezirke auf. In jedem einzelnen kann die Gruppe zu klein sein, um zu gewinnen.

segments.src: - **Adjusting competitive districts.** Moving a few neighborhoods or counties can turn a toss-up seat into a safer one for either side.
segments.tr: - **Anpassung von umkämpften Bezirken.** Das Verschieben einiger Nachbarschaften oder Bezirke kann einen Wackelsitz in einen sichereren für die eine oder andere Seite verwandeln.

segments.src: These techniques are lawful in some forms and unlawful in others.
segments.tr: Diese Techniken sind in einigen Formen rechtmäßig und in anderen unrechtmäßig.

segments.src: Courts are often asked to draw that line.
segments.tr: Gerichte werden oft gebeten, diese Grenze zu ziehen.

segments.src: ## The Role of the Courts
segments.tr: ## Die Rolle der Gerichte

segments.src: Several kinds of legal questions come up in redistricting cases.
segments.tr: In Neugliederungsverfahren treten verschiedene Arten von Rechtsfragen auf.

segments.src: **Federal law.** Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act bars maps that dilute the voting power of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: **Bundesrecht.** Abschnitt 2 des Voting Rights Act verbietet Karten, die die Wahlmacht von Rassen- oder Sprachminderheiten verwässern.

segments.src: The Equal Protection Clause also limits how much race may be used when drawing lines.
segments.tr: Die Equal Protection Clause schränkt auch ein, wie stark die Rasse beim Ziehen von Linien verwendet werden darf.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has handled many cases on how these rules apply, and its decisions shape what lower courts do.
segments.tr: Der Oberste Gerichtshof hat viele Fälle darüber behandelt, wie diese Regeln gelten, und seine Entscheidungen prägen das Handeln untergeordneter Gerichte.

segments.src: **Partisan gerrymandering.** In 2019, the Supreme Court held in *Rucho v.
segments.tr: **Parteiliches Gerrymandering.** Im Jahr 2019 entschied der Oberste Gerichtshof in der Rechtssache *Rucho gegen

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause*, dass Bundesgerichte keine Behauptungen entscheiden können, dass eine Karte zu parteiisch ist.

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: Das Gericht erklärte, diese Streitigkeiten seien politische Fragen, die außerhalb der Reichweite der Bundesjustiz liegen.

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: Die Entscheidung überließ Herausforderungen den Landesgerichten und dem Landesrecht.

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **Landesverfassungen.** Viele Landesverfassungen enthalten Klauseln über „freie und faire Wahlen“ oder spezifische Standards für die Neugliederung, wie Kompaktheit oder das Zusammenhalten von Gemeinschaften.

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: Oberste Landesgerichte in mehreren Bundesstaaten haben diese Bestimmungen genutzt, um Kongresskarten zu überprüfen und in einigen Fällen abzulehnen.

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **Zeitplan.** Wahlkalender sind wichtig.

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: Gerichte prüfen oft, ob das Ändern einer Karte kurz vor einer Wahl Wähler verwirren oder Wahlbeamte belasten würde.

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: Richter erlauben manchmal, dass eine angefochtene Karte für eine Wahl an Ort und Stelle bleibt, während das Verfahren weitergeht.

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: Aufgrund dieser Ebenen kann eine Karte von einem Gericht für ungültig erklärt, von einem anderen wiederhergestellt und dann erneut überprüft werden.

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: Urteile können kurz vor Einreichungsfristen oder Vorwahlen eintreffen.

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## Wie Urteile das Machtverhältnis verschieben können

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: Eine Gerichtsentscheidung kann das Repräsentantenhaus auf verschiedene Weise beeinflussen:

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **Sitze, die den Besitzer wechseln.** Wenn eine Karte verworfen und ersetzt wird, können einige Bezirke für eine bestimmte Partei vorteilhafter oder weniger vorteilhafter werden.

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **Entscheidungen der Kandidaten.** Amtsinhaber und Herausforderer entscheiden basierend auf dem Bezirk, den sie vertreten würden, ob und wo sie kandidieren.

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: 3. **Fundraising und Aufmerksamkeit.** Nationale Gruppen leiten Geld und Freiwillige in Bezirke, die sie als wettbewerbsfähig ansehen. Eine neue Karte kann diese Ziele verschieben oder entfernen.

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **Wählerverwirrung.** Wähler finden sich möglicherweise in einem neuen Bezirk mit anderen Kandidaten wieder und erfahren dies möglicherweise erst spät im Zyklus.

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: Niemand kann genau vorhersagen, wie sich eine neue Karte verhalten wird.

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: Wahlbeteiligung, Kandidatenqualität, die nationale Stimmung und die Wirtschaft beeinflussen die Ergebnisse.

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: Eine Karte ist ein Ausgangspunkt, keine Garantie.

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## Warum Wähler sich kümmern sollten

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: Die Neugliederung mag technisch erscheinen, aber sie prägt einige grundlegende Teile der Repräsentation:

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.
segments.tr: - **Wer Sie vertritt.** Ihr Bezirk bestimmt, für welches Mitglied des Kongresses Sie stimmen und wer Ihre Fallbearbeitung übernimmt, wie etwa Hilfe bei Bundesbehörden.

segments.src: - **How competitive your elections are.** In a very safe district, the general election may matter less than the primary.

segments.src: - **Whether communities stay together.** Lines can keep a town, county, or region whole, or divide it among several districts.
segments.tr: - **Ob Gemeinschaften zusammenbleiben.** Linien können eine Stadt, einen Landkreis oder eine Region intakt halten oder auf mehrere Bezirke aufteilen.

segments.src: - **Confidence in elections.** Fights over maps can affect how much people trust the process, whatever their politics.
segments.tr: - **Vertrauen in Wahlen.** Kämpfe um Karten können beeinflussen, wie sehr die Menschen dem Prozess vertrauen, unabhängig von ihrer Politik.

segments.src: ## What You Can Do
segments.tr: ## Was Sie tun können

segments.tr: - **Überprüfen Sie Ihren Bezirk.** Nutzen Sie die Website des Wahlbüros Ihres Bundesstaates oder einen überparteilichen Wählerleitfaden, um Ihren aktuellen Bezirk vor jeder Wahl zu bestätigen. Er hat sich möglicherweise geändert.

segments.src: - **Verify your registration.** Confirm your registration, polling place, and deadlines with your state or local election office.
segments.tr: - **Überprüfen Sie Ihre Registrierung.** Bestätigen Sie Ihre Registrierung, Ihr Wahllokal und Ihre Fristen bei Ihrem staatlichen oder lokalen Wahlbüro.

segments.src: - **Follow reliable sources.** Look for coverage from established news outlets and nonpartisan organizations that track redistricting litigation. Court dockets and official state sites are the most direct sources.
segments.tr: - **Folgen Sie zuverlässigen Quellen.** Suchen Sie nach Berichterstattung von etablierten Nachrichtenmedien und überparteilichen Organisationen, die Rechtsstreitigkeiten zur Neugliederung verfolgen. Gerichtsdokumente und offizielle staatliche Websites sind die direktesten Quellen.

segments.src: - **Take part in public processes.** Many states hold hearings or accept public comments on proposed maps. Showing up or submitting comments is one direct way to be heard.
segments.tr: - **Nehmen Sie an öffentlichen Prozessen teil.** Viele Bundesstaaten halten Anhörungen ab oder nehmen öffentliche Kommentare zu vorgeschlagenen Karten an. Zu erscheinen oder Kommentare einzureichen ist ein direkter Weg, um gehört zu werden.

segments.tr: - **Wählen Sie bei jeder Wahl.** Vorwahlen und lokale Rennen entscheiden oft darüber, wer die Macht über spätere Neugliederungsentscheidungen hat.

segments.src: A map can be redrawn sooner for several reasons:
segments.tr: Một bản đồ có thể được vẽ lại sớm hơn vì một số lý do:

segments.src: - **A court strikes down an existing map.** A judge may find that a map violates the U.S. Constitution, the Voting Rights Act, or a state constitution. The state must then adopt a replacement.
segments.tr: - **Tòa án bác bỏ một bản đồ hiện hành.** Một thẩm phán có thể thấy rằng một bản đồ vi phạm Hiến pháp Hoa Kỳ, Đạo luật Quyền Bầu cử hoặc hiến pháp tiểu bang. Tiểu bang đó sau đó phải thông qua một bản đồ thay thế.

segments.src: - **A legislature chooses to redraw.** In many states, lawmakers can pass a new map at any time unless state law says otherwise.
segments.tr: - **Cơ quan lập pháp chọn vẽ lại.** Ở nhiều tiểu bang, các nhà lập pháp có thể thông qua một bản đồ mới bất cứ lúc nào trừ khi luật tiểu bang quy định khác.

segments.src: - **A state's rules change.** A ballot measure, a new state court interpretation, or a change in a state's redistricting commission can all prompt a new map.
segments.tr: - **Các quy tắc của tiểu bang thay đổi.** Một biện pháp trưng cầu ý dân, một cách giải thích mới của tòa án tiểu bang, hoặc sự thay đổi trong ủy ban phân chia lại khu vực bầu cử của tiểu bang đều có thể thúc đẩy một bản đồ mới.

segments.src: - **A competing state responds.** When one state redraws, officials in other states sometimes weigh whether to do the same.
segments.tr: - **Một tiểu bang cạnh tranh phản hồi.** Khi một tiểu bang vẽ lại bản đồ, các quan chức ở các tiểu bang khác đôi khi cân nhắc xem có nên làm điều tương tự hay không.

segments.src: Each state follows its own rules.
segments.tr: Mỗi tiểu bang tuân theo các quy tắc riêng của mình.

segments.src: Some give the legislature the main role.
segments.tr: Một số tiểu bang giao vai trò chính cho cơ quan lập pháp.

segments.src: Others use independent or bipartisan commissions.
segments.tr: Những tiểu bang khác sử dụng các ủy ban độc lập hoặc lưỡng đảng.

segments.src: Still others split the work between the two.
segments.tr: Và những tiểu bang khác nữa chia sẻ công việc giữa cả hai bên.

segments.src: ## Why Small Changes Can Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## Tại Sao Những Thay Đổi Nhỏ Lại Có Thể Rất Quan Trọng

segments.src: The House has 435 voting seats, and control often comes down to a handful of them.
segments.tr: Hạ viện có 435 ghế có quyền biểu quyết, và quyền kiểm soát thường phụ thuộc vào một số ít trong số đó.

segments.src: Recent majorities have been narrow, so shifting even a few competitive districts can change which party controls the chamber.
segments.tr: Các đa số gần đây rất sít sao, vì vậy việc chuyển dịch thậm chí chỉ một vài khu vực bầu cử cạnh tranh có thể thay đổi đảng nào kiểm soát phòng họp này.

segments.src: Mapmakers have a few common tools:
segments.tr: Những người vẽ bản đồ có một số công cụ phổ biến:

segments.src: - **"Packing"** puts many of one group's voters into a single district. That group wins that seat by a wide margin, and its voting strength is smaller in neighboring districts.
segments.tr: - **"Đồn ép" ("Packing")** đặt nhiều cử tri của một nhóm vào một khu vực bầu cử duy nhất. Nhóm đó giành chiến thắng ở chiếc ghế đó với tỷ lệ áp đảo, và sức mạnh bầu cử của họ sẽ nhỏ hơn ở các khu vực bầu cử lân cận.

segments.src: - **"Cracking"** splits a group's voters across several districts. In each one the group may be too small to win.
segments.tr: - **"Chia nhỏ" ("Cracking")** phân tách các cử tri của một nhóm ra nhiều khu vực bầu cử khác nhau. Ở mỗi khu vực, nhóm đó có thể quá nhỏ để giành chiến thắng.

segments.src: - **Adjusting competitive districts.** Moving a few neighborhoods or counties can turn a toss-up seat into a safer one for either side.
segments.tr: - **Điều chỉnh các khu vực bầu cử cạnh tranh.** Di chuyển một vài khu phố hoặc quận có thể biến một ghế tranh chấp sít sao thành một ghế an toàn hơn cho bất kỳ bên nào.

segments.src: These techniques are lawful in some forms and unlawful in others.
segments.tr: Các kỹ thuật này hợp pháp dưới một số hình thức và bất hợp pháp dưới các hình thức khác.

segments.src: Courts are often asked to draw that line.
segments.tr: Các tòa án thường được yêu cầu để vạch ra ranh giới đó.

segments.src: ## The Role of the Courts
segments.tr: ## Vai Trò Của Các Tòa Án

segments.src: Several kinds of legal questions come up in redistricting cases.
segments.tr: Nhiều loại câu hỏi pháp lý phát sinh trong các vụ kiện phân chia lại khu vực bầu cử.

segments.src: **Federal law.** Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act bars maps that dilute the voting power of racial or language minority groups.
segments.tr: **Luật liên bang.** Mục 2 của Đạo luật Quyền Bầu cử cấm các bản đồ làm suy yếu quyền lực bầu cử của các nhóm thiểu số chủng tộc hoặc ngôn ngữ.

segments.src: The Equal Protection Clause also limits how much race may be used when drawing lines.
segments.tr: Điều khoản Bảo vệ Bình đẳng cũng hạn chế mức độ sử dụng yếu tố chủng tộc khi vẽ các đường ranh giới.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has handled many cases on how these rules apply, and its decisions shape what lower courts do.
segments.tr: Tòa án Tối cao đã xử lý nhiều vụ án về cách các quy tắc này được áp dụng, và các quyết định của tòa định hình những gì các tòa án cấp dưới thực hiện.

segments.tr: **Hành vi thao túng bản đồ bầu cử vì lợi ích đảng phái.** Vào năm 2019, Tòa án Tối cao đã phán quyết trong vụ *Rucho kiện

segments.src: Common Cause* that federal courts cannot decide claims that a map is too partisan.
segments.tr: Common Cause* rằng các tòa án liên bang không thể giải quyết các khiếu nại cho rằng một bản đồ mang tính đảng phái quá mức.

segments.src: The Court said those disputes are political questions outside the federal judiciary's reach.
segments.tr: Tòa án cho biết các tranh chấp đó là vấn đề chính trị nằm ngoài tầm với của tư pháp liên bang.

segments.src: The decision left challenges to state courts and state law.
segments.tr: Quyết định này để lại các thách thức cho các tòa án tiểu bang và luật tiểu bang.

segments.src: **State constitutions.** Many state constitutions include "free and fair elections" clauses or specific standards for redistricting, such as compactness or keeping communities together.
segments.tr: **Hiến pháp tiểu bang.** Nhiều hiến pháp tiểu bang bao gồm các điều khoản "bầu cử tự do và công bằng" hoặc các tiêu chuẩn cụ thể cho việc phân chia lại khu vực bầu cử, chẳng hạn như sự gọn gàng hoặc giữ các cộng đồng lại với nhau.

segments.src: State supreme courts in several states have used these provisions to review and, in some cases, reject congressional maps.
segments.tr: Tòa án tối cao ở một số tiểu bang đã sử dụng các điều khoản này để xem xét và trong một số trường hợp, bác bỏ các bản đồ quốc hội.

segments.src: **Timing.** Election calendars matter.
segments.tr: **Thời gian.** Lịch trình bầu cử rất quan trọng.

segments.src: Courts often consider whether changing a map close to an election would confuse voters or burden election officials.
segments.tr: Các tòa án thường xem xét việc thay đổi bản đồ gần thời điểm bầu cử có làm cử tri bối rối hay gây gánh nặng cho các quan chức bầu cử hay không.

segments.src: Judges sometimes allow a challenged map to stay in place for one election while the case continues.
segments.tr: Các thẩm phán đôi khi cho phép một bản đồ bị kiện được giữ nguyên cho một cuộc bầu cử trong khi vụ án tiếp tục diễn ra.

segments.src: Because of these layers, a map can be struck down in one court, restored by another, and then reviewed again.
segments.tr: Do các tầng lớp này, một bản đồ có thể bị bác bỏ ở tòa án này, được khôi phục bởi tòa án khác, và sau đó lại được xem xét lại.

segments.src: Rulings can arrive close to filing deadlines or primaries.
segments.tr: Các phán quyết có thể đến sát thời hạn nộp hồ sơ hoặc bầu cử sơ bộ.

segments.src: ## How Rulings Can Shift the Balance of Power
segments.tr: ## Các Phán Quyết Có Thể Thay Đổi Cân Bằng Quyền Lực Như Thế Nào

segments.src: A court decision can affect the House in several ways:
segments.tr: Một quyết định của tòa án có thể ảnh hưởng đến Hạ viện theo một số cách:

segments.src: 1. **Seats that change hands.** If a map is thrown out and replaced, some districts may become more or less favorable to a given party.
segments.tr: 1. **Các ghế đổi chủ.** Nếu một bản đồ bị vứt bỏ và thay thế, một số khu vực bầu cử có thể trở nên thuận lợi hơn hoặc ít thuận lợi hơn đối với một đảng nhất định.

segments.src: 2. **Candidate decisions.** Incumbents and challengers decide whether to run, and where, based on the district they would represent.
segments.tr: 2. **Các quyết định của ứng cử viên.** Những người đương nhiệm và thách thức quyết định có nên tranh cử hay không, và ở đâu, dựa trên khu vực bầu cử mà họ sẽ đại diện.

segments.src: 3. **Fundraising and attention.** National groups direct money and volunteers to districts they see as competitive. A new map can move or remove those targets.
segments.tr: 3. **Gây quỹ và sự chú ý.** Các nhóm quốc gia hướng tiền và tình nguyện viên đến các khu vực bầu cử mà họ coi là cạnh tranh. Một bản đồ mới có thể di chuyển hoặc loại bỏ các mục tiêu đó.

segments.src: 4. **Voter confusion.** Voters may find themselves in a new district with different candidates, and may not learn this until late in the cycle.
segments.tr: 4. **Sự bối rối của cử tri.** Cử tri có thể thấy mình ở một khu vực bầu cử mới với các ứng cử viên khác nhau, và có thể không biết điều này cho đến tận giai đoạn cuối của chu kỳ.

segments.src: No one can predict exactly how a new map will perform.
segments.tr: Không ai có thể dự đoán chính xác một bản đồ mới sẽ hoạt động như thế nào.

segments.src: Turnout, candidate quality, the national mood, and the economy all affect results.
segments.tr: Tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu, chất lượng ứng cử viên, tâm trạng quốc gia, và nền kinh tế đều ảnh hưởng đến kết quả.

segments.src: A map is a starting point, not a guarantee.
segments.tr: Một bản đồ chỉ là điểm khởi đầu, không phải là sự đảm bảo.

segments.src: ## Why Voters Should Care
segments.tr: ## Tại Sao Cử Tri Nên Quan Tâm

segments.src: Redistricting can seem technical, but it shapes some basic parts of representation:
segments.tr: Việc phân chia lại khu vực bầu cử có vẻ mang tính kỹ thuật, nhưng nó định hình một số phần cơ bản của việc đại diện:

segments.src: - **Who represents you.** Your district determines which member of Congress you vote for and who handles your casework, such as help with federal agencies.
segments.tr: - **Ai đại diện cho bạn.** Khu vực bầu cử của bạn quyết định thành viên Quốc hội nào mà bạn bỏ phiếu bầu và ai xử lý các công việc liên quan đến cử tri của bạn, chẳng hạn như giúp đỡ với các cơ quan liên bang.

segments.src: - **How competitive your elections are.** In a very safe district, the general election may matter less than the primary.
segments.tr: - **Các cuộc bầu cử của bạn cạnh tranh đến mức nào.** Trong một khu vực bầu cử rất an toàn, cuộc bầu cử tổng tuyển cử có thể ít quan trọng hơn cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ.

segments.src: - **Whether communities stay together.** Lines can keep a town, county, or region whole, or divide it among several districts.
segments.tr: - **Liệu các cộng đồng có được giữ lại với nhau không.** Các đường ranh giới có thể giữ cho một thị trấn, quận, hoặc vùng được nguyên vẹn, hoặc chia cắt nó giữa nhiều khu vực bầu cử.

segments.src: - **Confidence in elections.** Fights over maps can affect how much people trust the process, whatever their politics.
segments.tr: - **Niềm tin vào các cuộc bầu cử.** Các cuộc chiến về bản đồ có thể ảnh hưởng đến mức độ mọi người tin tưởng vào quy trình, bất kể chính kiến của họ là gì.

segments.src: ## What You Can Do
segments.tr: ## Bạn Có Thể Làm Gì

segments.src: - **Check your district.** Use your state election office's website or a nonpartisan voter guide to confirm your current district before every election. It may have changed.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm tra khu vực bầu cử của bạn.** Sử dụng trang web của văn phòng bầu cử tiểu bang của bạn hoặc hướng dẫn cử tri phi đảng phái để xác nhận khu vực bầu cử hiện tại của bạn trước mọi cuộc bầu cử. Nó có thể đã thay đổi.

segments.src: - **Verify your registration.** Confirm your registration, polling place, and deadlines with your state or local election office.
segments.tr: - **Xác minh đăng ký của bạn.** Xác nhận việc đăng ký, địa điểm bỏ phiếu, và thời hạn của bạn với văn phòng bầu cử tiểu bang hoặc địa phương của bạn.

segments.src: - **Follow reliable sources.** Look for coverage from established news outlets and nonpartisan organizations that track redistricting litigation. Court dockets and official state sites are the most direct sources.
segments.tr: - **Theo dõi các nguồn tin đáng tin cậy.** Tìm kiếm thông tin đưa tin từ các hãng tin tức uy tín và các tổ chức phi đảng phái theo dõi vụ kiện tụng phân chia lại khu vực bầu cử. Các hồ sơ tòa án và trang web chính thức của tiểu bang là các nguồn trực tiếp nhất.

segments.src: - **Take part in public processes.** Many states hold hearings or accept public comments on proposed maps. Showing up or submitting comments is one direct way to be heard.
segments.tr: - **Tham gia vào các quy trình công khai.** Nhiều tiểu bang tổ chức các phiên điều trần hoặc nhận ý kiến đóng góp của công chúng về các bản đồ được đề xuất. Việc xuất hiện hoặc gửi ý kiến là một cách trực tiếp để tiếng nói của bạn được lắng nghe.

segments.src: - **Vote in every election.** Primaries and local races often decide who has power over later redistricting decisions.
segments.tr: - **Bỏ phiếu trong mọi cuộc bầu cử.** Các cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ và bầu cử địa phương thường quyết định ai nắm quyền đối với các quyết định phân chia lại khu vực bầu cử sau đó.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm Mấu Chốt

segments.src: Mid-decade redistricting fights show how much depends on the details of how lines are drawn and who gets to decide.
segments.tr: Các cuộc chiến phân chia lại khu vực bầu cử giữa thập kỷ cho thấy có bao nhiêu thứ phụ thuộc vào các chi tiết về cách các đường ranh giới được vẽ và ai là người quyết định.

segments.src: Courts at the state and federal level are now weighing which maps will stand, and their rulings can affect which party controls the House.
segments.tr: Các tòa án ở cấp tiểu bang và liên bang hiện đang cân nhắc xem bản đồ nào sẽ được giữ lại, và các phán quyết của họ có thể ảnh hưởng đến việc đảng nào kiểm soát Hạ viện.

segments.src: Voters of all views are best served by knowing their district, checking the rules before they vote, and relying on trustworthy sources while the legal picture keeps changing.
segments.tr: Cử tri với mọi quan điểm sẽ được phục vụ tốt nhất bằng cách biết rõ khu vực bầu cử của họ, kiểm tra các quy tắc trước khi bỏ phiếu, và dựa vào các nguồn tin đáng tin cậy trong khi bức tranh pháp lý liên tục thay đổi.
